sentences.en: It was a gray morning in London, and I sat with Holmes at the table in our room on Baker Street.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v un:o matin:n gris:a à:o Londres:o ,:o et:o j':o étais:v attablé:a avec:o Holmes:o dans:o notre:o salon:n de:o Baker:o Street:o .:o

sentences.en: A stick lay across the table, for a visitor had left it there the night before while we were out.
sentences.tgt: Une:o canne:n reposait:v en:o travers:n de:o la:o table:n ,:o car:o un:o visiteur:n l':o avait:v laissée:v là:a la:o veille:n au:o soir:n ,:o pendant:o notre:o absence:n .:o

sentences.en: It was a thick stick with a round top, and a band of gold ran around the top.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v une:o canne:n épaisse:a ,:o à:o pommeau:n rond:a ,:o et:o une:o virole:n d':o or:n entourait:v le:o pommeau:n .:o

sentences.en: On the band were the words "To Doctor Mortimer, from his friends at the hospital."
sentences.tgt: Sur:o la:o virole:n étaient:v gravés:a ces:o mots:n ::o «:o Au:o docteur:n Mortimer:o ,:o de:o la:o part:n de:o ses:o amis:n de:o l':o hôpital:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Holmes sat with his back to me and did not turn his head, but he began to speak.
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o me:o tournait:v le:o dos:n et:o ne:o se:o retourna:v pas:o ,:o mais:o il:o se:o mit:v à:o parler:v .:o

sentences.en: "Watson, you are looking at that stick, so tell me what you think of the man who owns it," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Watson:o ,:o vous:o regardez:v cette:o canne:n ,:o dites:v -moi:o donc:o ce:o que:o vous:o pensez:v de:o l':o homme:n à:o qui:o elle:o appartient:v ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "How did you know that I was looking at it?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Comment:a saviez:v -vous:o que:o je:o la:o regardais:v ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "There is a silver pot on the table in front of me, and it shows me your face," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o y:o a:v une:o cafetière:n en:o argent:n sur:o la:o table:n ,:o devant:o moi:o ,:o et:o elle:o me:o renvoie:v votre:o visage:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: I looked at the stick for a long time, and then I told Holmes what I thought.
sentences.tgt: J':o examinai:v longuement:a la:o canne:n ,:o puis:a je:o dis:v à:o Holmes:o ce:o que:o j':o en:o pensais:v .:o

sentences.en: "He is an old doctor from the country, and his friends gave him this stick because they like him," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v un:o vieux:a médecin:n de:o campagne:n ,:o et:o ses:o amis:n lui:o ont:v offert:v cette:o canne:n parce:o qu':o ils:o l':o aiment:v bien:a ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "You are close, Watson, but I think that you are wrong about some of it," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o n':o êtes:v pas:o loin:a ,:o Watson:o ,:o mais:o je:o crois:v que:o vous:o vous:o trompez:v sur:o certains:o points:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "The band says that his friends were at a hospital, so he worked there before he went to the country."
sentences.tgt: «:o D':o après:o la:o virole:n ,:o ses:o amis:n étaient:v dans:o un:o hôpital:n ;:o il:o y:o a:v donc:o travaillé:v avant:o de:o partir:v pour:o la:o campagne:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "A young doctor leaves a hospital to work in the country, but an old doctor does not, so this man is young."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o jeune:a médecin:n quitte:v l':o hôpital:n pour:o exercer:v à:o la:o campagne:n ,:o mais:o un:o vieux:a médecin:n ne:o le:o fait:v pas:o ;:o notre:o homme:n est:v donc:o jeune:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The end of the stick is worn down, for he walks far."
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o bout:n de:o la:o canne:n est:v usé:a ,:o car:o il:o marche:v beaucoup:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "A doctor in the country must walk far to reach the people who are sick."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o médecin:n de:o campagne:n doit:v faire:v beaucoup:a de:o chemin:n à:o pied:n pour:o aller:v voir:v ses:o malades:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Look at the top of the stick, for there are marks of teeth on it."
sentences.tgt: «:o Regardez:v le:o pommeau:n ,:o car:o il:o porte:v des:o marques:n de:o dents:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "A dog has carried this stick in its mouth, and I think that the dog is not a small one."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o chien:n a:v porté:v cette:o canne:n dans:o sa:o gueule:n ,:o et:o je:o crois:v que:o ce:o chien:n n':o est:v pas:o petit:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "How can you know that?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Comment:a pouvez:v -vous:o savoir:v cela:o ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "The marks are far apart, so the mouth of the dog is wide," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o marques:n sont:v très:a écartées:a ;:o la:o gueule:n du:o chien:n est:v donc:o large:a ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He is a young doctor with a big dog, and he walks far in the country," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v un:o jeune:a médecin:n qui:o a:v un:o gros:a chien:n ,:o et:o il:o marche:v beaucoup:a dans:o la:o campagne:n ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "I hear a man on the stairs, and I think that he is the doctor," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o entends:v quelqu'un:o dans:o l':o escalier:n ,:o et:o je:o crois:v que:o c':o est:v notre:o docteur:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "I am glad, for I want to ask him about his dog."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o en:o suis:v ravi:a ,:o car:o je:o veux:v l':o interroger:v sur:o son:o chien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The door opened, and a tall thin man walked into the room.
sentences.tgt: La:o porte:n s':o ouvrit:v ,:o et:o un:o homme:n grand:a et:o maigre:a entra:v dans:o la:o pièce:n .:o

sentences.en: He was young, with a long nose and gray eyes, and a dog ran in behind him.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v jeune:a ,:o avec:o un:o long:a nez:n et:o des:o yeux:n gris:a ,:o et:o un:o chien:n entra:v en:o courant:v derrière:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: "I am Doctor Mortimer, and I came here last night, but you were not at home," the man said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o suis:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o ,:o je:o suis:v venu:v hier:a soir:n ,:o mais:o vous:o n':o étiez:v pas:o là:a ,:o »:o dit:v l':o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: "That is my stick, and I am glad to see it again."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v ma:o canne:n ,:o et:o je:o suis:v heureux:a de:o la:o retrouver:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "You have a big dog, and it carries your stick," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o avez:v un:o gros:a chien:n ,:o et:o c':o est:v lui:o qui:o porte:v votre:o canne:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "You were a doctor at a hospital, and you left it to work in the country."
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o étiez:v médecin:n dans:o un:o hôpital:n ,:o et:o vous:o l':o avez:v quitté:v pour:o exercer:v à:o la:o campagne:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Doctor Mortimer looked at Holmes with surprise.
sentences.tgt: Le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o regarda:v Holmes:o avec:o étonnement:n .:o

sentences.en: "Yes, that is true, but how do you know it?" he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Oui:o ,:o c':o est:v vrai:a ,:o mais:o comment:a le:o savez:v -vous:o ?:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "I have looked at your stick," Holmes said, "and now you must sit down and tell me why you came."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v examiné:v votre:o canne:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o ,:o «:o et:o maintenant:a ,:o asseyez:v -vous:o et:o dites:v -moi:o pourquoi:a vous:o êtes:v venu:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: Doctor Mortimer sat down and was silent for a moment.
sentences.tgt: Le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o s':o assit:v et:o garda:v un:o instant:n le:o silence:n .:o

sentences.en: "I have come to you because I do not know what to do," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o suis:v venu:v vous:o voir:v parce:o que:o je:o ne:o sais:v pas:o quoi:o faire:v ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: Doctor Mortimer took a paper and sat down.
sentences.tgt: Le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o prit:v un:o papier:n et:o s':o assit:v .:o

sentences.en: "This is an old story about the Baskervilles, and it is told in Devon," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v une:o vieille:a histoire:n sur:o les:o Baskerville:o ,:o que:o l':o on:o raconte:v dans:o le:o Devon:o ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will read it to you, and then you will know why I came."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v vous:o la:o lire:v ,:o et:o vous:o comprendrez:v alors:a pourquoi:a je:o suis:v venu:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: Holmes sat and did not say a word.
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o resta:v assis:a sans:o dire:v un:o mot:n .:o

sentences.en: Doctor Mortimer read the paper to Holmes and me.
sentences.tgt: Le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o nous:o lut:v le:o papier:n ,:o à:o Holmes:o et:o à:o moi:o .:o

sentences.en: In old times Hugo Baskerville lived in the Hall, and he was a cruel man.
sentences.tgt: Jadis:a ,:o Hugo:o Baskerville:o vivait:v au:o manoir:n ,:o et:o c':o était:v un:o homme:n cruel:a .:o

sentences.en: Near the Hall a girl lived on a farm with her father.
sentences.tgt: Près:o du:o manoir:n ,:o une:o jeune:a fille:n vivait:v dans:o une:o ferme:n avec:o son:o père:n .:o

sentences.en: Hugo wanted the girl, but she was afraid of him.
sentences.tgt: Hugo:o convoitait:v la:o jeune:a fille:n ,:o mais:o elle:o avait:v peur:n de:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: One night Hugo and his friends took the girl from her father's farm to a room at the top of the Hall.
sentences.tgt: Une:o nuit:n ,:o Hugo:o et:o ses:o amis:n enlevèrent:v la:o jeune:a fille:n à:o la:o ferme:n de:o son:o père:n et:o l':o enfermèrent:v dans:o une:o chambre:n ,:o tout:a en:o haut:n du:o manoir:n .:o

sentences.en: The girl was afraid, and she got out of the room and ran across the moor to her father's farm.
sentences.tgt: La:o jeune:a fille:n avait:v peur:n ,:o elle:o s':o échappa:v de:o la:o chambre:n et:o s':o enfuit:v à:o travers:n la:o lande:n vers:o la:o ferme:n de:o son:o père:n .:o

sentences.en: The farm was far away.
sentences.tgt: La:o ferme:n était:v loin:a .:o

sentences.en: After a time Hugo went up to the room and found that the girl was gone.
sentences.tgt: Au:o bout:n d':o un:o moment:n ,:o Hugo:o monta:v à:o la:o chambre:n et:o découvrit:v que:o la:o jeune:a fille:n avait:v disparu:v .:o

sentences.en: He ran down to his friends and said, "I will give my soul to the devil if I do not get her!"
sentences.tgt: Il:o redescendit:v en:o courant:v auprès:o de:o ses:o amis:n et:o s':o écria:v ::o «:o Je:o donnerai:v mon:o âme:n au:o diable:n si:o je:o ne:o la:o rattrape:v pas:o !:o »:o

sentences.en: Hugo and his friends got on their horses, and the hounds ran with them.
sentences.tgt: Hugo:o et:o ses:o amis:n sautèrent:v en:o selle:n ,:o et:o la:o meute:n courut:v avec:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: The men rode out on the moor in the night.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n partirent:v à:o cheval:n sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o dans:o la:o nuit:n .:o

sentences.en: On the moor the men met a shepherd, and they asked him if he had seen the girl.
sentences.tgt: Sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o ils:o croisèrent:v un:o berger:n et:o lui:o demandèrent:v s':o il:o avait:v vu:v la:o jeune:a fille:n .:o

sentences.en: "I saw a girl, and Hugo Baskerville rode after her, and a great black hound ran behind him," the shepherd said.
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v vu:v une:o jeune:a fille:n ,:o et:o Hugo:o Baskerville:o la:o poursuivait:v à:o cheval:n ,:o et:o un:o énorme:a chien:n noir:a courait:v derrière:o lui:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o berger:n .:o

sentences.en: "I would not want a hound like that behind me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o voudrais:v pas:o d':o un:o chien:n pareil:a à:o mes:o trousses:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The men did not stop, and they rode on across the moor.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n ne:o s':o arrêtèrent:v pas:o ,:o et:o ils:o poursuivirent:v leur:o course:n à:o travers:n la:o lande:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon they saw the horse of Hugo run by with no man on its back.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a ,:o ils:o virent:v passer:v le:o cheval:n de:o Hugo:o ,:o sans:o cavalier:n .:o

sentences.en: The girl lay dead on the moor, for she was afraid and she had run so far.
sentences.tgt: La:o jeune:a fille:n gisait:v morte:a sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o car:o elle:o avait:v eu:v si:a peur:n et:o couru:v si:a loin:a .:o

sentences.en: Near her lay Hugo Baskerville, and he was dead.
sentences.tgt: Près:o d':o elle:o gisait:v Hugo:o Baskerville:o ,:o et:o il:o était:v mort:a .:o

sentences.en: Over him stood a great black hound.
sentences.tgt: Au-dessus:o de:o lui:o se:o tenait:v un:o énorme:a chien:n noir:a .:o

sentences.en: The hound had torn out the throat of Hugo, and its eyes were red.
sentences.tgt: Le:o chien:n avait:v déchiré:v la:o gorge:n de:o Hugo:o ,:o et:o ses:o yeux:n étaient:v rouges:a .:o

sentences.en: The hound looked at the men, and they rode away, and one of them died that night.
sentences.tgt: Le:o chien:n regarda:v les:o hommes:n ,:o et:o ils:o s':o enfuirent:v au:o galop:n ,:o et:o l':o un:o d':o eux:o mourut:v cette:o nuit:n -là:o .:o

sentences.en: Doctor Mortimer looked at Holmes.
sentences.tgt: Le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o leva:v les:o yeux:n vers:o Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "Men see the hound on the moor, and it kills the men of the Baskerville family," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o On:o voit:v le:o chien:n sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o et:o il:o tue:v les:o hommes:n de:o la:o famille:n Baskerville:o ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "The paper ends with a warning to the sons: do not go on the moor at night."
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o texte:n se:o termine:v par:o un:o avertissement:n aux:o fils:n ::o ne:o vous:o aventurez:v pas:o sur:o la:o lande:n la:o nuit:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Holmes looked at Doctor Mortimer and said, "That is a story for a child, but why do you read it to me?"
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o regarda:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o et:o dit:v ::o «:o C':o est:v un:o conte:n pour:o enfants:n ,:o mais:o pourquoi:a me:o le:o lisez:v -vous:o ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "I read it to you because a Baskerville is dead," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vous:o le:o lis:v parce:o qu':o un:o Baskerville:o est:v mort:a ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "Sir Charles Baskerville was my friend as well as my patient," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o Baskerville:o était:v mon:o ami:n autant:a que:o mon:o patient:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "He was a good man, but his heart was weak, and he knew the story of the hound."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o était:v un:o homme:n bon:a ,:o mais:o il:o avait:v le:o cœur:n fragile:a ,:o et:o il:o connaissait:v la:o légende:n du:o chien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "It made him afraid of the moor at night, yet every night he walked alone on a path near the Hall."
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o lui:o faisait:v redouter:v la:o lande:n la:o nuit:n ,:o et:o pourtant:a ,:o chaque:o soir:n ,:o il:o se:o promenait:v seul:a dans:o une:o allée:n près:o du:o manoir:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The path runs between two rows of old trees, and at the end of it there is a gate that opens onto the moor."
sentences.tgt: «:o Cette:o allée:n est:v bordée:a de:o deux:o rangées:n de:o vieux:a arbres:n ,:o et:o au:o bout:n se:o trouve:v une:o barrière:n qui:o donne:v sur:o la:o lande:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "One night he told me that he would go to London in the morning."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o soir:n ,:o il:o m':o a:v dit:v qu':o il:o partirait:v pour:o Londres:o le:o lendemain:n matin:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "That night he went out to his path as he did every night, but he did not come back."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o soir:n -là:o ,:o il:o est:v sorti:v faire:v un:o tour:n dans:o son:o allée:n comme:o chaque:o soir:n ,:o mais:o il:o n':o est:v jamais:o revenu:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "In the morning his servant Barrymore found him dead on the path, and he ran to my house to tell me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Au:o matin:n ,:o son:o domestique:n ,:o Barrymore:o ,:o l':o a:v trouvé:v mort:a dans:o l':o allée:n ,:o et:o il:o a:v couru:v chez:o moi:o me:o prévenir:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I went with him to the Hall, and there was no mark on Sir Charles."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o l':o ai:v accompagné:v au:o manoir:n ,:o et:o sir:o Charles:o ne:o portait:v aucune:o trace:n de:o violence:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But his face was the face of a man who had been in great fear."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o son:o visage:n était:v celui:o d':o un:o homme:n qui:o avait:v eu:v terriblement:a peur:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I said that his heart was weak and that he had died of it, and the other men said the same."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v déclaré:v qu':o il:o avait:v le:o cœur:n fragile:a et:o qu':o il:o en:o était:v mort:v ,:o et:o les:o autres:o ont:v dit:v la:o même:a chose:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But I looked at the ground near the body and saw a mark, and no one else saw it," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o j':o ai:v examiné:v le:o sol:n près:o du:o corps:n et:o j':o y:o ai:v vu:v une:o empreinte:n ,:o que:o personne:o d':o autre:o n':o a:v remarquée:v ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "What was the mark?" Holmes asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Quelle:o empreinte:n ?:o »:o demanda:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "It was the mark of a foot, and it was not the foot of a man," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o était:v l':o empreinte:n d':o un:o pied:n ,:o et:o ce:o n':o était:v pas:o un:o pied:n humain:a ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "The marks were larger than the marks of any hound that I know."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ces:o empreintes:n étaient:v plus:a grandes:a que:o celles:o de:o tous:o les:o chiens:n que:o je:o connais:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "You saw the marks of a hound near the body?" Holmes asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o avez:v vu:v des:o empreintes:n de:o chien:n près:o du:o corps:n ?:o »:o demanda:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "Yes, and no one saw them but me," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Oui:o ,:o et:o personne:o ne:o les:o a:v vues:v à:o part:n moi:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: Holmes looked at me, and then he looked at Doctor Mortimer for a long time.
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o me:o regarda:v ,:o puis:a il:o observa:v longuement:a le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "You saw this on the night when Sir Charles died, and you have come to me only now," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o avez:v vu:v cela:o la:o nuit:n où:o sir:o Charles:o est:v mort:v ,:o et:o vous:o ne:o venez:v me:o voir:v que:o maintenant:a ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "Why did you not come to me at once?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a n':o êtes:v -vous:o pas:o venu:v tout:a de:o suite:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "I did not want men to say that a hound had killed a Baskerville, for they would have laughed at me," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o voulais:v pas:o qu':o on:o dise:v qu':o un:o chien:n avait:v tué:v un:o Baskerville:o ,:o car:o on:o se:o serait:v moqué:v de:o moi:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "But I have heard more since that night."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o depuis:o cette:o nuit:n ,:o j':o en:o ai:v appris:v davantage:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Men on the moor have seen a great black hound in the dark, and their story is the story of the paper."
sentences.tgt: «:o Des:o gens:n de:o la:o lande:n ont:v aperçu:v un:o énorme:a chien:n noir:a dans:o l':o obscurité:n ,:o et:o leur:o récit:n est:v exactement:a celui:o du:o texte:n que:o je:o vous:o ai:v lu:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "They are afraid, and they will not walk on the moor at night."

sentences.en: "Were there other marks on the path?" Holmes asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Y:o avait:v -il:o d':o autres:o empreintes:n dans:o l':o allée:n ?:o »:o demanda:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "There were the marks of Sir Charles," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o y:o avait:v celles:o de:o sir:o Charles:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "He stood at the gate for a long time, for I found the ash of his cigar on the ground."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o est:v resté:v longtemps:a devant:o la:o barrière:n ,:o car:o j':o ai:v trouvé:v la:o cendre:n de:o son:o cigare:n par:o terre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "After that he went down the path, and the marks show that he ran."

sentences.en: "He ran from the hound," Holmes said, "and he was afraid, and his heart was weak."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o fuyait:v le:o chien:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o ,:o «:o il:o était:v terrifié:a ,:o et:o il:o avait:v le:o cœur:n fragile:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I think that is true," Doctor Mortimer said, "but I do not know what to do."

sentences.en: "Sir Charles had no son," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o n':o avait:v pas:o de:o fils:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "The Hall will go to the son of his brother, and the young man is Sir Henry Baskerville."

sentences.en: "Sir Henry is in Canada, and he will come to London tomorrow."
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Henry:o vit:v au:o Canada:o ,:o et:o il:o arrive:v demain:a à:o Londres:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He is the last of the Baskervilles, and I do not want him to die."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v le:o dernier:n des:o Baskerville:o ,:o et:o je:o ne:o veux:v pas:o qu':o il:o meure:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He will be at the station at 10 in the morning, and I will meet him."

sentences.en: "Must I take him to the Hall?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Dois:v -je:o l':o emmener:v au:o manoir:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "Every Baskerville who comes to the Hall is in danger, and Sir Charles is dead."
sentences.tgt: «:o Tout:o Baskerville:o qui:o s':o installe:v au:o manoir:n est:v en:o danger:n ,:o et:o sir:o Charles:o est:v mort:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Do you think the devil has done this?" Holmes asked.

sentences.en: "Men on the moor have seen the hound, and I saw the marks with my own eyes."

sentences.en: "A hound from the devil would not leave the mark of a foot on the path," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o chien:n du:o diable:n ne:o laisserait:v pas:o d':o empreintes:n dans:o l':o allée:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "If a foot made the marks, then the hound is a hound like other hounds, and a man can find it."
sentences.tgt: «:o Si:o ce:o sont:v des:o pattes:n qui:o ont:v laissé:v ces:o empreintes:n ,:o alors:a ce:o chien:n est:v un:o chien:n comme:o les:o autres:o ,:o et:o on:o peut:v le:o retrouver:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "You think that the hound is a real hound?" Doctor Mortimer asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o pensez:v que:o c':o est:v un:o vrai:a chien:n ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know yet," Holmes said, "and I must think about it."

sentences.en: "Meet Sir Henry at the station, and tell him nothing."

sentences.en: "Take him to a hotel, and bring him here the next day at 12, and I will tell you what to do."

sentences.en: "I will come at 12 with Sir Henry," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o viendrai:v à:o midi:n avec:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "Thank you," Holmes said, and Doctor Mortimer went away.

sentences.en: Holmes sat in his chair and smoked all night.

sentences.en: In the morning the room was full of smoke, and Holmes was still in his chair.

sentences.en: "Watson, I have thought about the hound all night," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Watson:o ,:o j':o ai:v pensé:v au:o chien:n toute:o la:o nuit:n ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know yet, but he must not go to the Hall alone," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o le:o sais:v pas:o encore:a ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o doit:v pas:o aller:v seul:a au:o manoir:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "I know that a man made the mark, for a hound from the devil would not leave one."

sentences.en: "But I do not know who the man is, and I do not know why he wants to kill a Baskerville."

sentences.en: Two days later, at 12, Doctor Mortimer came back to Baker Street with a young man.
sentences.tgt: Deux:o jours:n plus:a tard:a ,:o à:o midi:n ,:o le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o revint:v à:o Baker:o Street:o avec:o un:o jeune:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: The young man was Sir Henry Baskerville, a strong man with black eyes and a brown face, and he had lived in Canada.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v sir:o Henry:o Baskerville:o ,:o un:o homme:n robuste:a aux:o yeux:n noirs:a et:o au:o teint:n hâlé:a ,:o qui:o avait:v vécu:v au:o Canada:o .:o

sentences.en: "Sir Henry, I am Sherlock Holmes, and this is my friend Doctor Watson," Holmes said.

sentences.en: "Something strange happened to me this morning, and I want you to see it," Sir Henry said.

sentences.en: He took a letter from his coat and gave it to Holmes, and Holmes held it up to the window.

sentences.en: "The man cut these words from the newspaper of yesterday," Holmes said.

sentences.en: "The word moor was not in the newspaper, so he wrote that word himself."

sentences.en: "There is a faint smell of scent on the paper, and it is a scent that a woman wears," Holmes said.

sentences.en: "A man does not take one boot for nothing," Holmes said, and he looked at the letter again.

sentences.tgt: «:o Quelqu'un:o a:v suivi:v sir:o Henry:o jusqu':o à:o l':o hôtel:n ,:o et:o je:o crois:v qu':o il:o va:v recommencer:v ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: We went down to the street, and we saw the two men walk away.

sentences.tgt: «:o L':o employé:n de:o l':o hôtel:n affirme:v qu':o il:o n':o en:o sait:v rien:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "First he took a new boot, and now he has taken an old one," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o D':o abord:a ,:o il:o a:v pris:v une:o bottine:n neuve:a ,:o et:o maintenant:a ,:o une:o vieille:a ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know why he wants them, Sir Henry, but I will find out."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ignore:v pourquoi:a il:o les:o veut:v ,:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o mais:o je:o le:o découvrirai:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: That night the driver of the cab came to our room, for Holmes had sent for him.
sentences.tgt: Le:o soir:n même:a ,:o le:o cocher:n du:o fiacre:n vint:v nous:o voir:v ,:o car:o Holmes:o l':o avait:v fait:v chercher:v .:o

sentences.en: "The man was a tall man with a black beard, and he told me to follow the two men," the driver said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o était:v un:o homme:n grand:a avec:o une:o barbe:n noire:a ,:o et:o il:o m':o a:v demandé:v de:o suivre:v les:o deux:o messieurs:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o cocher:n .:o

sentences.en: "I asked his name, and he said that his name was Sherlock Holmes."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o lui:o ai:v demandé:v son:o nom:n ,:o et:o il:o m':o a:v répondu:v qu':o il:o s':o appelait:v Sherlock:o Holmes:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Holmes laughed and said, "He is a clever man, Watson."
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o éclata:v de:o rire:n et:o dit:v ::o «:o C':o est:v un:o homme:n habile:a ,:o Watson:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He knew that we would follow him, and he wanted us to know his name."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o savait:v que:o nous:o le:o suivrions:v ,:o et:o il:o voulait:v que:o nous:o connaissions:v son:o nom:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Who is he, and why does he follow Sir Henry?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qui:o est:v -ce:o ,:o et:o pourquoi:a suit:v -il:o sir:o Henry:o ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know," Holmes said, "but I think he has followed Sir Henry since the day he came to London."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o l':o ignore:v ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o ,:o «:o mais:o je:o crois:v qu':o il:o suit:v sir:o Henry:o depuis:o le:o jour:n de:o son:o arrivée:n à:o Londres:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Someone wants him to stay away from the moor, and someone wants to watch him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Quelqu'un:o veut:v l':o éloigner:v de:o la:o lande:n ,:o et:o quelqu'un:o veut:v le:o surveiller:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "You must go with Sir Henry to the Hall, Watson, and you must find this man."
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o devez:v accompagner:v sir:o Henry:o au:o manoir:n ,:o Watson:o ,:o et:o trouver:v cet:o homme:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I will go on Saturday with Sir Henry and Doctor Mortimer," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o partirai:v samedi:n avec:o sir:o Henry:o et:o le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: On Saturday Holmes came with us to the station.
sentences.tgt: Le:o samedi:n ,:o Holmes:o nous:o accompagna:v à:o la:o gare:n .:o

sentences.en: "Do not leave Sir Henry alone on the moor at night, Watson," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ne:o laissez:v jamais:o sir:o Henry:o seul:a sur:o la:o lande:n la:o nuit:n ,:o Watson:o ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "Trust no one, and send me a letter every day."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ne:o vous:o fiez:v à:o personne:o ,:o et:o écrivez:v -moi:o chaque:o jour:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The train went out of London, and I looked at Holmes until I could not see him.
sentences.tgt: Le:o train:n quitta:v Londres:o ,:o et:o je:o suivis:v Holmes:o des:o yeux:n jusqu':o à:o ce:o que:o je:o le:o perde:v de:o vue:n .:o

sentences.en: In the afternoon we came to a small station, and two soldiers stood there with guns.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o l':o après-midi:n ,:o nous:o arrivâmes:v à:o une:o petite:a gare:n où:o se:o tenaient:v deux:o soldats:n armés:a de:o fusils:n .:o

sentences.en: A driver took our bags and put them in a carriage.
sentences.tgt: Un:o cocher:n prit:v nos:o bagages:n et:o les:o chargea:v dans:o une:o calèche:n .:o

sentences.en: "Why are the soldiers here?" Sir Henry asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a y:o a:v -t-il:o des:o soldats:n ici:a ?:o »:o demanda:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "A man has run away from the prison at Princetown," the driver said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o homme:n s':o est:v évadé:v du:o bagne:n de:o Princetown:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o cocher:n .:o

sentences.en: "His name is Selden, and he killed a man in London."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o s':o appelle:v Selden:o ,:o et:o il:o a:v tué:v un:o homme:n à:o Londres:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He has been on the moor for three days, and the soldiers have not found him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o se:o cache:v sur:o la:o lande:n depuis:o trois:o jours:n ,:o et:o les:o soldats:n ne:o l':o ont:v pas:o retrouvé:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The farmers are afraid, for they know that he is a bad man."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o paysans:n ont:v peur:n ,:o car:o ils:o savent:v que:o c':o est:v un:o homme:n dangereux:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I am not afraid of one man," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o homme:n seul:a ne:o me:o fait:v pas:o peur:n ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "But I do not like the moor at night, and I think it is a bad place."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o je:o n':o aime:v pas:o la:o lande:n la:o nuit:n ,:o et:o je:o trouve:v que:o c':o est:v un:o endroit:n sinistre:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: We got into the carriage, and the driver took us out onto the moor.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o montâmes:v dans:o la:o calèche:n ,:o et:o le:o cocher:n nous:o emmena:v sur:o la:o lande:n .:o

sentences.en: The road went up and down, and the moor was all around us.
sentences.tgt: La:o route:n montait:v et:o descendait:v ,:o et:o la:o lande:n s':o étendait:v tout:a autour:o de:o nous:o .:o

sentences.en: The moor was brown and gray, and the sun went down behind the hills.
sentences.tgt: La:o lande:n était:v brune:a et:o grise:a ,:o et:o le:o soleil:n se:o couchait:v derrière:o les:o collines:n .:o

sentences.en: "There are no houses here, and no one walks on this moor at night," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o n':o y:o a:v pas:o de:o maisons:n par:o ici:a ,:o et:o personne:o ne:o s':o aventure:v sur:o cette:o lande:n la:o nuit:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry looked at the moor for a long time and said nothing.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o contempla:v longuement:a la:o lande:n sans:o rien:o dire:v .:o

sentences.en: On a hill we saw a soldier on a horse, and he had a gun.
sentences.tgt: Sur:o une:o colline:n ,:o nous:o aperçûmes:v un:o soldat:n à:o cheval:n ,:o le:o fusil:n à:o la:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: At last the carriage came to a gate, and we went in, and there was the Hall.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a ,:o la:o calèche:n arriva:v devant:o une:o grille:n ,:o nous:o la:o franchîmes:v ,:o et:o le:o manoir:n apparut:v .:o

sentences.en: The Hall was a great old house with two towers, and it was dark.
sentences.tgt: Le:o manoir:n était:v une:o vaste:a demeure:n ancienne:a flanquée:a de:o deux:o tours:n ,:o et:o elle:o était:v plongée:a dans:o l':o obscurité:n .:o

sentences.en: Barrymore and his wife came out of the door to meet us.
sentences.tgt: Barrymore:o et:o sa:o femme:n sortirent:v pour:o nous:o accueillir:v .:o

sentences.en: Barrymore had a thick black beard, and he took our bags from the carriage.
sentences.tgt: Barrymore:o portait:v une:o épaisse:a barbe:n noire:a ,:o et:o il:o descendit:v nos:o bagages:n de:o la:o calèche:n .:o

sentences.en: "We are glad that you have come to the Hall, Sir Henry," Barrymore said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o sommes:v heureux:a de:o vous:o accueillir:v au:o manoir:n ,:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o dit:v Barrymore:o .:o

sentences.en: Doctor Mortimer said good night and went to his house, and we went into the Hall.
sentences.tgt: Le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o nous:o souhaita:v bonne:a nuit:n et:o rentra:v chez:o lui:o ,:o et:o nous:o entrâmes:v dans:o le:o manoir:n .:o

sentences.en: The room was dark, and there were pictures of dead Baskervilles on the walls.
sentences.tgt: La:o salle:n était:v sombre:a ,:o et:o les:o murs:n étaient:v couverts:a de:o portraits:n de:o Baskerville:o défunts:a .:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry looked at the faces of his family for a long time.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o contempla:v longuement:a les:o visages:n de:o sa:o famille:n .:o

sentences.en: "This is not a good house, Watson, and I do not like it," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Cette:o maison:n n':o a:v rien:o de:o bon:a ,:o Watson:o ,:o et:o elle:o ne:o me:o plaît:v pas:o ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "Sir Charles lived here alone, and he was afraid of the moor."
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o vivait:v seul:a ici:a ,:o et:o il:o avait:v peur:n de:o la:o lande:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I know why."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o comprends:v pourquoi:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Sir Henry, my wife and I want to leave the Hall now," Barrymore said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Henry:o ,:o ma:o femme:n et:o moi:o souhaiterions:v quitter:v le:o manoir:n dès:o maintenant:a ,:o »:o dit:v Barrymore:o .:o

sentences.en: "Sir Charles was good to us, and he left us gold when he died."
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o était:v bon:a pour:o nous:o ,:o et:o il:o nous:o a:v légué:v de:o l':o argent:n à:o sa:o mort:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "We can have a small house now, and the Hall is not the same, for Sir Charles is dead."
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o pouvons:v maintenant:a nous:o offrir:v une:o petite:a maison:n ,:o et:o le:o manoir:n n':o est:v plus:o le:o même:a depuis:o la:o mort:n de:o sir:o Charles:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Stay here for some time," Sir Henry said, "for I want you."
sentences.tgt: «:o Restez:v encore:a quelque:o temps:n ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o ,:o «:o car:o j':o ai:v besoin:n de:o vous:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "We will stay, Sir Henry," Barrymore said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o resterons:v ,:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o dit:v Barrymore:o .:o

sentences.en: We ate that night in the great room, and then we went to our rooms.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o soir:n -là:o ,:o nous:o dînâmes:v dans:o la:o grande:a salle:n ,:o puis:a nous:o montâmes:v dans:o nos:o chambres:n .:o

sentences.en: I could not sleep, and I lay in the dark.
sentences.tgt: Je:o ne:o parvins:v pas:o à:o dormir:v ,:o et:o je:o restai:v étendu:a dans:o l':o obscurité:n .:o

sentences.en: In the night I heard a sound in the Hall.
sentences.tgt: Au:o cours:n de:o la:o nuit:n ,:o j':o entendis:v un:o bruit:n dans:o le:o manoir:n .:o

sentences.en: It was the sound of a woman who was crying.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v une:o femme:n qui:o pleurait:v .:o

sentences.en: I got up and listened at the door, but the sound was far away, and I could not tell where it was.
sentences.tgt: Je:o me:o levai:v et:o tendis:v l':o oreille:n à:o la:o porte:n ,:o mais:o le:o bruit:n était:v lointain:a ,:o et:o je:o ne:o pus:v dire:v d':o où:o il:o venait:v .:o

sentences.en: The sound came again, and then it was gone.
sentences.tgt: Le:o bruit:n reprit:v ,:o puis:a il:o cessa:v .:o

sentences.en: In the morning I told Sir Henry about it.
sentences.tgt: Le:o matin:n ,:o j':o en:o parlai:v à:o sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "I heard it too," Sir Henry said, "and it was a woman."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o l':o ai:v entendu:v ,:o moi:o aussi:a ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o ,:o «:o et:o c':o était:v bien:a une:o femme:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Barrymore came into the room, and Sir Henry asked him, "Did you hear a woman in the night?"
sentences.tgt: Barrymore:o entra:v dans:o la:o pièce:n ,:o et:o sir:o Henry:o lui:o demanda:v ::o «:o Avez:v -vous:o entendu:v une:o femme:n cette:o nuit:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "No, Sir Henry," Barrymore said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Non:o ,:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o répondit:v Barrymore:o .:o

sentences.en: "There are only two women in the Hall, and my wife was in bed."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o n':o y:o a:v que:o deux:o femmes:n au:o manoir:n ,:o et:o ma:o femme:n était:v couchée:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: Barrymore's wife came into the room, and I saw that her eyes were red.
sentences.tgt: La:o femme:n de:o Barrymore:o entra:v à:o son:o tour:n ,:o et:o je:o vis:v qu':o elle:o avait:v les:o yeux:n rouges:a .:o

sentences.en: I think that she had been crying, and I think that Barrymore was not telling the truth.
sentences.tgt: Je:o crois:v qu':o elle:o avait:v pleuré:v ,:o et:o je:o crois:v que:o Barrymore:o ne:o disait:v pas:o la:o vérité:n .:o

sentences.en: "Why was she crying, and why does her husband say that she was not?" I asked Sir Henry.
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a pleurait:v -elle:o ,:o et:o pourquoi:a son:o mari:n le:o nie:v -t-il:o ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o à:o sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o n':o en:o sais:v rien:o ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "I do not like a house where a woman cries in the night and no one will say why."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o n':o aime:v pas:o une:o maison:n où:o une:o femme:n pleure:v la:o nuit:n sans:o que:o personne:o veuille:v dire:v pourquoi:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: I thought of the man in the cab, for he had a black beard like Barrymore.
sentences.tgt: Je:o repensai:v à:o l':o homme:n du:o fiacre:n ,:o car:o il:o avait:v une:o barbe:n noire:a ,:o comme:o Barrymore:o .:o

sentences.en: I did not know if Barrymore had been in London, so I wrote to Holmes and asked him to find out.
sentences.tgt: J':o ignorais:v si:o Barrymore:o était:v allé:v à:o Londres:o ,:o et:o j':o écrivis:v donc:o à:o Holmes:o pour:o lui:o demander:v de:o le:o vérifier:v .:o

sentences.en: After breakfast Sir Henry sat down with the papers of the Hall, for the Hall was his now.
sentences.tgt: Après:o le:o petit-déjeuner:n ,:o sir:o Henry:o se:o plongea:v dans:o les:o papiers:n du:o domaine:n ,:o car:o le:o manoir:n lui:o appartenait:v désormais:a .:o

sentences.en: "Watson, I must work at these papers, and I cannot go out today," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Watson:o ,:o je:o dois:v étudier:v ces:o papiers:n ,:o et:o je:o ne:o peux:v pas:o sortir:v aujourd'hui:a ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will go out for a walk on the moor," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v aller:v me:o promener:v sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "Do not go far, and take your gun, for Selden is on the moor," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o N':o allez:v pas:o trop:a loin:a ,:o et:o prenez:v votre:o arme:n ,:o car:o Selden:o rôde:v sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: It was a cold morning, and the sun was on the hills.
sentences.tgt: La:o matinée:n était:v froide:a ,:o et:o le:o soleil:n éclairait:v les:o collines:n .:o

sentences.en: I took my gun and went out of the Hall and up onto the moor.
sentences.tgt: Je:o pris:v mon:o arme:n ,:o sortis:v du:o manoir:n et:o montai:v sur:o la:o lande:n .:o

sentences.en: I walked on the moor for an hour, and I saw no one.
sentences.tgt: Je:o marchai:v une:o heure:n sur:o la:o lande:n sans:o rencontrer:v personne:o .:o

sentences.en: A man came after me, and he ran across the moor with a net in his hand.
sentences.tgt: Un:o homme:n me:o rattrapa:v en:o courant:v à:o travers:n la:o lande:n ,:o un:o filet:n à:o la:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: He was a thin man with light hair, and he looked at me with a smile.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v un:o homme:n mince:a aux:o cheveux:n clairs:a ,:o et:o il:o me:o regarda:v en:o souriant:v .:o

sentences.en: "Doctor Watson, I think?" the man said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o docteur:n Watson:o ,:o si:o je:o ne:o me:o trompe:v ?:o »:o dit:v l':o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: "I am Stapleton, and I live at Merripit House on the moor."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o m':o appelle:v Stapleton:o ,:o et:o j':o habite:v Merripit:o House:o ,:o sur:o la:o lande:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Doctor Mortimer is my friend, and he told me that you have come to the Hall," Stapleton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o est:v un:o ami:n ,:o et:o il:o m':o a:v appris:v votre:o arrivée:n au:o manoir:n ,:o »:o dit:v Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: "I catch butterflies on the moor, and I know every part of it."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o chasse:v les:o papillons:n sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o et:o j':o en:o connais:v chaque:o recoin:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Is it a good place to walk?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Est:v -ce:o un:o bon:a endroit:n pour:o se:o promener:v ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "It is a bad place, if you do not know it," Stapleton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v un:o endroit:n dangereux:a ,:o quand:o on:o ne:o le:o connaît:v pas:o ,:o »:o dit:v Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: "Look at that green place, Doctor Watson, for that is the Grimpen Mire."
sentences.tgt: «:o Voyez:v cette:o tache:n verte:a ,:o docteur:n Watson:o ::o c':o est:v la:o grande:a fondrière:n de:o Grimpen:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Yesterday I saw a horse walk into it, and the horse did not come out."
sentences.tgt: «:o Hier:a ,:o j':o ai:v vu:v un:o cheval:n s':o y:o aventurer:v ,:o et:o il:o n':o en:o est:v jamais:o ressorti:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "There is a path through the mire, but I am the only man who knows it."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o existe:v un:o sentier:n qui:o traverse:v la:o fondrière:n ,:o mais:o je:o suis:v le:o seul:a à:o le:o connaître:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "A man who does not know the path walks into the mire, and he dies there."
sentences.tgt: «:o Celui:o qui:o ne:o connaît:v pas:o le:o sentier:n s':o enfonce:v dans:o la:o fondrière:n et:o y:o meurt:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: Just then I heard a long low sound, and it came from far away on the moor.
sentences.tgt: À:o cet:o instant:n ,:o j':o entendis:v un:o long:a cri:n sourd:a qui:o venait:v de:o très:a loin:a sur:o la:o lande:n .:o

sentences.en: "Do you hear that?" Stapleton asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o entendez:v ?:o »:o demanda:v Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: "What is it?" I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qu':o est:v -ce:o que:o c':o est:v ?:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "The people here say that it is the hound of the Baskervilles," Stapleton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o gens:n d':o ici:a disent:v que:o c':o est:v le:o chien:n des:o Baskerville:o ,:o »:o dit:v Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: "I think that it is the mire, or a bird, but I do not know."

sentences.en: "It said, 'Please burn this letter, and be at the gate at 10 o'clock,' and under the words were two letters."
sentences.tgt: «:o On:o y:o lisait:v ::o OQ:o Je:o vous:o en:o prie:v ,:o brûlez:v cette:o lettre:n et:o soyez:v à:o la:o barrière:n à:o dix:o heures:n CQ:o ,:o et:o en:o dessous:a figuraient:v deux:o initiales:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Why did you not tell this to the men?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a n':o en:o avez:v -vous:o rien:o dit:v aux:o enquêteurs:n ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "Sir Charles was a good man, and I did not want people to say bad things about him," Barrymore said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o était:v un:o homme:n bon:a ,:o et:o je:o ne:o voulais:v pas:o qu':o on:o dise:v du:o mal:n de:o lui:o ,:o »:o dit:v Barrymore:o .:o

sentences.en: "What were the letters?" Sir Henry asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Quelles:o étaient:v ces:o initiales:n ?:o »:o demanda:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "They were L. L.," Barrymore said.
sentences.tgt: «:o L.:o L.:o ,:o »:o répondit:v Barrymore:o .:o

sentences.en: "A woman with those letters lives at Coombe Tracey, and Doctor Mortimer will know who she is," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Une:o femme:n qui:o porte:v ces:o initiales:n vit:v à:o Coombe:o Tracey:o ,:o et:o le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o saura:v qui:o elle:o est:v ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "Sir Charles went to the gate that night, and I think he went to meet her," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o est:v allé:v à:o la:o barrière:n ce:o soir:n -là:o ,:o et:o je:o crois:v qu':o il:o allait:v la:o retrouver:v ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will ask Doctor Mortimer about her tomorrow," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Demain:a ,:o j':o interrogerai:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o à:o son:o sujet:n ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "Barrymore, show your light in the window tonight," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Barrymore:o ,:o mettez:v votre:o lumière:n à:o la:o fenêtre:n ce:o soir:n ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "Selden will come for his food, and we will go out and find him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Selden:o viendra:v chercher:v sa:o nourriture:n ,:o et:o nous:o sortirons:v pour:o le:o trouver:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Please do not hurt him, Sir Henry," Barrymore said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vous:o en:o prie:v ,:o ne:o lui:o faites:v pas:o de:o mal:n ,:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o dit:v Barrymore:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will not hurt him, but he must not walk on the moor," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o lui:o ferai:v pas:o de:o mal:n ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o doit:v plus:o errer:v sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: Barrymore went away, and Sir Henry looked at me.
sentences.tgt: Barrymore:o se:o retira:v ,:o et:o sir:o Henry:o se:o tourna:v vers:o moi:o .:o

sentences.en: "We will go out tonight, Watson, and we will take our guns," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o sortirons:v cette:o nuit:n ,:o Watson:o ,:o et:o nous:o prendrons:v nos:o armes:n ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: That night Sir Henry and I went out onto the moor with our guns.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o nuit:n -là:o ,:o sir:o Henry:o et:o moi:o partîmes:v sur:o la:o lande:n avec:o nos:o armes:n .:o

sentences.en: The moon was up, and the moor was bright, and we could see the path for a long way.
sentences.tgt: La:o lune:n s':o était:v levée:v ,:o la:o lande:n était:v claire:a ,:o et:o nous:o distinguions:v le:o sentier:n très:a loin:a devant:o nous:o .:o

sentences.en: Barrymore had put the candle in the window, and we walked away from the Hall.
sentences.tgt: Barrymore:o avait:v placé:v la:o bougie:n à:o la:o fenêtre:n ,:o et:o nous:o nous:o éloignâmes:v du:o manoir:n .:o

sentences.en: After a long time we saw a small light on a hill, and Sir Henry said, "That is Selden."
sentences.tgt: Au:o bout:n d':o un:o long:a moment:n ,:o nous:o aperçûmes:v une:o petite:a lueur:n sur:o une:o colline:n ,:o et:o sir:o Henry:o dit:v ::o «:o C':o est:v Selden:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: We ran toward the light, and it went out.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o courûmes:v vers:o la:o lueur:n ,:o et:o elle:o s':o éteignit:v .:o

sentences.en: For a moment I saw a face in the dark, and it was the face of a thin man with a wild beard.
sentences.tgt: Un:o instant:n ,:o j':o entrevis:v un:o visage:n dans:o l':o obscurité:n ,:o celui:o d':o un:o homme:n maigre:a à:o la:o barbe:n hirsute:a .:o

sentences.en: The man ran away across the stones and down a hill, and Sir Henry ran after him.
sentences.tgt: L':o homme:n s':o enfuit:v à:o travers:n les:o pierres:n et:o dévala:v une:o colline:n ,:o et:o sir:o Henry:o se:o lança:v à:o sa:o poursuite:n .:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry called to him, but he did not stop.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o l':o appela:v ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o s':o arrêta:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: I ran too, but the man was fast, and he knew the moor better than we did.
sentences.tgt: Je:o courus:v moi:o aussi:a ,:o mais:o l':o homme:n était:v rapide:a ,:o et:o il:o connaissait:v la:o lande:n mieux:a que:o nous:o .:o

sentences.en: At last we stopped, and we stood in the dark and did not speak.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a ,:o nous:o nous:o arrêtâmes:v et:o restâmes:v immobiles:a dans:o l':o obscurité:n ,:o sans:o un:o mot:n .:o

sentences.en: A long low cry came from the moor, and it was the sound that I had heard with Stapleton.
sentences.tgt: Un:o long:a cri:n sourd:a monta:v de:o la:o lande:n ,:o et:o je:o reconnus:v le:o cri:n que:o j':o avais:v entendu:v avec:o Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: "What is that, Watson?" Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qu':o est:v -ce:o que:o c':o est:v ,:o Watson:o ?:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o sais:v pas:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "It is the sound that people say is the hound."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v le:o cri:n que:o les:o gens:n attribuent:v au:o chien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I heard it once as a boy," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o l':o ai:v entendu:v une:o fois:n quand:o j':o étais:v enfant:n ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "I did not like it then, and I do not like it now."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o ne:o me:o plaisait:v pas:o alors:a ,:o et:o il:o ne:o me:o plaît:v pas:o davantage:a aujourd'hui:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: I looked up, and I saw a man on the top of a great rock.
sentences.tgt: Je:o levai:v les:o yeux:n et:o aperçus:v un:o homme:n au:o sommet:n d':o un:o grand:a rocher:n .:o

sentences.en: He was a tall thin man, and he stood still, and the moon was behind him.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v un:o homme:n grand:a et:o maigre:a ,:o immobile:a ,:o qui:o se:o découpait:v sur:o la:o lune:n .:o

sentences.en: He was not Selden, for Selden was a small man with a beard.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o n':o était:v pas:o Selden:o ,:o car:o Selden:o était:v petit:a et:o barbu:a .:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry did not see him, for he was looking at the ground.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o ne:o le:o vit:v pas:o ,:o car:o il:o regardait:v le:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: The man looked at us for a time, and then he turned and went away.
sentences.tgt: L':o homme:n nous:o observa:v un:o moment:n ,:o puis:a il:o se:o détourna:v et:o disparut:v .:o

sentences.en: "Who was that man?" I said to myself, and I was afraid.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qui:o était:v cet:o homme:n ?:o »:o me:o demandai:v -je:o ,:o et:o j':o avais:v peur:n .:o

sentences.en: I told Sir Henry about him on the way back, and Sir Henry said that we would look for him in the morning.
sentences.tgt: Sur:o le:o chemin:n du:o retour:n ,:o j':o en:o parlai:v à:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o qui:o déclara:v que:o nous:o le:o chercherions:v le:o lendemain:n matin:n .:o

sentences.en: Barrymore was waiting at the door of the Hall, and he asked if we had found Selden.
sentences.tgt: Barrymore:o attendait:v à:o la:o porte:n du:o manoir:n ,:o et:o il:o demanda:v si:o nous:o avions:v trouvé:v Selden:o .:o

sentences.en: "We did not find him," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o ne:o l':o avons:v pas:o trouvé:v ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: I did not sleep that night.
sentences.tgt: Je:o ne:o dormis:v pas:o de:o la:o nuit:n .:o

sentences.en: In the morning I went to the house of Doctor Mortimer, and I asked him who L. L. was.
sentences.tgt: Le:o matin:n ,:o je:o me:o rendis:v chez:o le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o et:o lui:o demandai:v qui:o était:v L.:o L.:o

sentences.en: "They are the letters of Laura Lyons, who lives at Coombe Tracey," Doctor Mortimer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o sont:v les:o initiales:n de:o Laura:o Lyons:o ,:o qui:o vit:v à:o Coombe:o Tracey:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o

sentences.en: "She is the daughter of an old man named Frankland, and her husband left her."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v la:o fille:n d':o un:o vieil:a homme:n du:o nom:n de:o Frankland:o ,:o et:o son:o mari:n l':o a:v abandonnée:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Her father would not help her, but Sir Charles was kind to her, and he gave her money."
sentences.tgt: «:o Son:o père:n a:v refusé:v de:o l':o aider:v ,:o mais:o sir:o Charles:o s':o est:v montré:v bon:a envers:o elle:o et:o lui:o a:v donné:v de:o l':o argent:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I must go to Coombe Tracey and see her," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o faut:v que:o j':o aille:v la:o voir:v à:o Coombe:o Tracey:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: I went to Coombe Tracey, and I found the house of Laura Lyons.
sentences.tgt: Je:o me:o rendis:v à:o Coombe:o Tracey:o ,:o où:o je:o trouvai:v la:o maison:n de:o Laura:o Lyons:o .:o

sentences.en: She was a young woman with brown hair and a strong face, and she looked at me with fear.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v une:o jeune:a femme:n aux:o cheveux:n châtains:a ,:o au:o visage:n énergique:a ,:o et:o elle:o me:o regarda:v avec:o crainte:n .:o

sentences.en: "I am Doctor Watson, a friend of Sir Henry Baskerville," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o suis:v le:o docteur:n Watson:o ,:o un:o ami:n de:o sir:o Henry:o Baskerville:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "I want to know about the letter that you wrote to Sir Charles."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o voudrais:v vous:o parler:v de:o la:o lettre:n que:o vous:o avez:v écrite:v à:o sir:o Charles:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I do not know what you mean," she said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o vois:v pas:o de:o quoi:o vous:o parlez:v ,:o »:o dit:v -elle:o .:o

sentences.en: "Barrymore found a piece of it in the fire, and I know that you wrote it," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Barrymore:o en:o a:v trouvé:v un:o morceau:n dans:o la:o cheminée:n ,:o et:o je:o sais:v que:o vous:o l':o avez:v écrite:v ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: She did not speak for a long time, and then she said, "Yes, I wrote to Sir Charles."
sentences.tgt: Elle:o garda:v longtemps:a le:o silence:n ,:o puis:a elle:o dit:v ::o «:o Oui:o ,:o j':o ai:v écrit:v à:o sir:o Charles:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "My husband left me, and I wanted to be free of him, but I had no money."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mon:o mari:n m':o avait:v abandonnée:v ,:o je:o voulais:v me:o libérer:v de:o lui:o ,:o mais:o je:o n':o avais:v pas:o d':o argent:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I asked Sir Charles for help, and I asked him to meet me at the gate at 10 o'clock."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v demandé:v de:o l':o aide:n à:o sir:o Charles:o ,:o et:o je:o lui:o ai:v donné:v rendez-vous:n à:o la:o barrière:n à:o dix:o heures:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I told him to burn the letter, for I did not want men to know."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o lui:o ai:v demandé:v de:o brûler:v la:o lettre:n ,:o car:o je:o ne:o voulais:v pas:o que:o l':o on:o sache:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Did you go to the gate?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Êtes:v -vous:o allée:v à:o la:o barrière:n ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "No, I did not go," she said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Non:o ,:o je:o n':o y:o suis:v pas:o allée:v ,:o »:o dit:v -elle:o .:o

sentences.en: "Someone else gave me help, so I did not need Sir Charles."
sentences.tgt: «:o Quelqu'un:o d':o autre:o m':o a:v aidée:v ,:o et:o je:o n':o avais:v donc:o plus:o besoin:n de:o sir:o Charles:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I did not know that he was dead until the next day."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o n':o ai:v appris:v sa:o mort:n que:o le:o lendemain:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Who was the man who helped you?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qui:o était:v l':o homme:n qui:o vous:o a:v aidée:v ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "I cannot tell you," she said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o peux:v pas:o vous:o le:o dire:v ,:o »:o dit:v -elle:o .:o

sentences.en: I went away from her house, and I thought about what she had said.
sentences.tgt: Je:o quittai:v sa:o maison:n en:o réfléchissant:v à:o ce:o qu':o elle:o m':o avait:v dit:v .:o

sentences.en: I knew that she had told the truth about the letter, but I did not think that she had told me all.
sentences.tgt: Je:o savais:v qu':o elle:o avait:v dit:v la:o vérité:n au:o sujet:n de:o la:o lettre:n ,:o mais:o je:o doutais:v qu':o elle:o m':o eût:v tout:o dit:v .:o

sentences.en: Someone had helped her, and I wanted to know his name.
sentences.tgt: Quelqu'un:o l':o avait:v aidée:v ,:o et:o je:o voulais:v connaître:v son:o nom:n .:o

sentences.en: The old man Frankland lived on the road to the Hall, and I decided to see him.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vieux:a Frankland:o habitait:v sur:o la:o route:n du:o manoir:n ,:o et:o je:o résolus:v d':o aller:v le:o voir:v .:o

sentences.en: On the road I met an old man with white hair and a red face.
