sentences.en: "I am Frankland, and I know that you are Doctor Watson," the old man said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o suis:v Frankland:o ,:o et:o je:o sais:v que:o vous:o êtes:v le:o docteur:n Watson:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o vieillard:n .:o

sentences.en: "I love the law, and I am always right."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o aime:v la:o loi:n ,:o et:o j':o ai:v toujours:a raison:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Laura Lyons is your daughter, is she not?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Laura:o Lyons:o est:v votre:o fille:n ,:o n':o est:v -ce:o pas:o ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "I do not speak of her," Frankland said, "for she went away with a man that I did not like."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o parle:v pas:o d':o elle:o ,:o »:o dit:v Frankland:o ,:o «:o car:o elle:o est:v partie:v avec:o un:o homme:n qui:o ne:o me:o plaisait:v pas:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: His face was redder now, and he did not want to say more.
sentences.tgt: Son:o teint:n était:v plus:a rouge:a encore:a ,:o et:o il:o ne:o voulut:v rien:o dire:v de:o plus:a .:o

sentences.en: "Come into my house, for I want to show you something," Frankland said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Entrez:v chez:o moi:o ,:o car:o je:o veux:v vous:o montrer:v quelque:o chose:n ,:o »:o dit:v Frankland:o .:o

sentences.en: Frankland took me up to the roof of his house, and there was a long glass on the roof.
sentences.tgt: Frankland:o me:o fit:v monter:v sur:o le:o toit:n de:o sa:o maison:n ,:o où:o se:o trouvait:v une:o longue:a lunette:n .:o

sentences.en: "This is a telescope, and I watch the moor with it every day."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v un:o télescope:n ,:o et:o je:o m':o en:o sers:v chaque:o jour:n pour:o surveiller:v la:o lande:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Look, Doctor Watson, for there is a boy on the hill."
sentences.tgt: «:o Regardez:v ,:o docteur:n Watson:o ,:o il:o y:o a:v un:o garçon:n sur:o la:o colline:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: I looked through the glass and saw a small boy with a bundle in his hand.
sentences.tgt: Je:o regardai:v dans:o la:o lunette:n et:o vis:v un:o petit:a garçon:n qui:o tenait:v un:o baluchon:n à:o la:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: The boy walked up the hill, and he went down behind it.
sentences.tgt: Le:o garçon:n gravit:v la:o colline:n ,:o puis:a il:o redescendit:v de:o l':o autre:a côté:n .:o

sentences.en: "He walks there every day, and I think that the bundle is food," Frankland said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o passe:v par:o là:a tous:o les:o jours:n ,:o et:o je:o crois:v que:o son:o baluchon:n contient:v de:o la:o nourriture:n ,:o »:o dit:v Frankland:o .:o

sentences.en: "It is for Selden, the convict, and I will tell the soldiers."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v pour:o Selden:o ,:o le:o forçat:n ,:o et:o je:o vais:v prévenir:v les:o soldats:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Please wait until I have seen the place," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Attendez:v ,:o je:o vous:o en:o prie:v ,:o que:o j':o aie:v vu:v l':o endroit:n ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will tell you what I find."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vous:o dirai:v ce:o que:o j':o y:o aurai:v trouvé:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I will wait," Frankland said, "but do not wait too long."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o attendrai:v ,:o »:o dit:v Frankland:o ,:o «:o mais:o ne:o tardez:v pas:o trop:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: I thanked Frankland and went out of his house.
sentences.tgt: Je:o remerciai:v Frankland:o et:o quittai:v sa:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: Barrymore gave food to Selden, so the boy did not bring food to Selden.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v Barrymore:o qui:o nourrissait:v Selden:o ;:o le:o garçon:n ne:o lui:o apportait:v donc:o pas:o à:o manger:v .:o

sentences.en: The boy brought food to another man, and I knew who he was.
sentences.tgt: Il:o apportait:v à:o manger:v à:o un:o autre:a homme:n ,:o et:o je:o savais:v qui:o c':o était:v .:o

sentences.en: He was the tall man on the rock, and he lived on the moor.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v l':o homme:n de:o haute:a taille:n du:o rocher:n ,:o et:o il:o vivait:v sur:o la:o lande:n .:o

sentences.en: I walked back toward the Hall and looked at the rock on the hill.
sentences.tgt: Je:o repris:v le:o chemin:n du:o manoir:n en:o regardant:v le:o rocher:n sur:o la:o colline:n .:o

sentences.en: "I will go to that rock tomorrow, and I will find him," I said to myself.
sentences.tgt: «:o Demain:a ,:o j':o irai:v à:o ce:o rocher:n ,:o et:o je:o le:o trouverai:v ,:o »:o me:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: The next day I went out alone, and I walked to the rock.
sentences.tgt: Le:o lendemain:n ,:o je:o sortis:v seul:a et:o me:o rendis:v au:o rocher:n .:o

sentences.en: On the hill near the rock I found small round houses of stone.
sentences.tgt: Sur:o la:o colline:n ,:o près:o du:o rocher:n ,:o je:o découvris:v de:o petites:a huttes:n rondes:a en:o pierre:n .:o

sentences.en: Men had lived in them in old times, and the roofs were gone.
sentences.tgt: Des:o hommes:n les:o avaient:v habitées:v autrefois:a ,:o et:o elles:o n':o avaient:v plus:o de:o toit:n .:o

sentences.en: In one of the houses a roof was still there, and I looked in at the door.
sentences.tgt: L':o une:o d':o elles:o avait:v encore:a son:o toit:n ,:o et:o je:o jetai:v un:o coup:n d':o œil:n par:o la:o porte:n .:o

sentences.en: On the floor was a blanket, and near it was some food.
sentences.tgt: Sur:o le:o sol:n était:v étendue:a une:o couverture:n ,:o et:o à:o côté:n se:o trouvaient:v quelques:o provisions:n .:o

sentences.en: "Someone lives here," I said to myself, "and he is the man on the rock."
sentences.tgt: «:o Quelqu'un:o vit:v ici:a ,:o »:o me:o dis:v -je:o ,:o «:o et:o c':o est:v l':o homme:n du:o rocher:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Under a stone I found a paper with words on it.
sentences.tgt: Sous:o une:o pierre:n ,:o je:o trouvai:v un:o papier:n sur:o lequel:o on:o avait:v écrit:v quelques:o mots:n .:o

sentences.en: The words said, "Doctor Watson has gone to Coombe Tracey."
sentences.tgt: On:o y:o lisait:v ::o «:o Le:o docteur:n Watson:o est:v allé:v à:o Coombe:o Tracey:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Someone watches me," I said, "and he sends a paper to say where I go."
sentences.tgt: «:o Quelqu'un:o me:o surveille:v ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o ,:o «:o et:o on:o lui:o envoie:v des:o billets:n pour:o lui:o dire:v où:o je:o vais:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: I sat down in the dark of the house with my gun, and I waited.
sentences.tgt: Je:o m':o assis:v dans:o la:o pénombre:n de:o la:o hutte:n ,:o mon:o arme:n à:o la:o main:n ,:o et:o j':o attendis:v .:o

sentences.en: The sun went down, and I heard a step outside.
sentences.tgt: Le:o soleil:n se:o coucha:v ,:o et:o j':o entendis:v un:o pas:n dehors:a .:o

sentences.en: I held my gun and did not move.
sentences.tgt: Je:o serrai:v mon:o arme:n sans:o bouger:v .:o

sentences.en: The step stopped at the door, and a voice said, "It is a fine night, my dear Watson."
sentences.tgt: Le:o pas:n s':o arrêta:v devant:o la:o porte:n ,:o et:o une:o voix:n dit:v ::o «:o Il:o fait:v bien:a beau:a ce:o soir:n ,:o mon:o cher:a Watson:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I think that you will be more comfortable outside than in the house."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o crois:v que:o vous:o serez:v mieux:a dehors:a que:o dans:o la:o hutte:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: I knew the voice, but I could not believe it.
sentences.tgt: Je:o connaissais:v cette:o voix:n ,:o mais:o je:o n':o en:o croyais:v pas:o mes:o oreilles:n .:o

sentences.en: I went out of the house, and a man sat on a stone with a smile on his face.
sentences.tgt: Je:o sortis:v de:o la:o hutte:n ,:o et:o un:o homme:n était:v assis:a sur:o une:o pierre:n ,:o le:o sourire:n aux:o lèvres:n .:o

sentences.en: "Holmes!" I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Holmes:o !:o »:o m':o écriai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "Why did you not tell me that you were on the moor?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a ne:o m':o avez:v -vous:o pas:o dit:v que:o vous:o étiez:v sur:o la:o lande:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "I wanted to be near you, but I wanted no one to know that I was here," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o voulais:v être:v près:o de:o vous:o ,:o mais:o je:o ne:o voulais:v pas:o que:o l':o on:o sache:v que:o j':o étais:v ici:a ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "I have lived in the stone house for some days, and I have watched you and Sir Henry."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vis:v dans:o cette:o hutte:n de:o pierre:n depuis:o quelques:o jours:n ,:o et:o je:o vous:o ai:v observés:v ,:o sir:o Henry:o et:o vous:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The boy with the food was Cartwright, and the paper was his."
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o garçon:n aux:o provisions:n ,:o c':o était:v Cartwright:o ,:o et:o le:o papier:n était:v de:o lui:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He brought me my food, and he told me where you went."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o m':o apportait:v à:o manger:v et:o me:o disait:v où:o vous:o alliez:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "You have done well, Watson, and I have read all your letters."
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o avez:v fait:v du:o bon:a travail:n ,:o Watson:o ,:o et:o j':o ai:v lu:v toutes:o vos:o lettres:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Tell me what has happened since your last letter, Watson," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Racontez:v -moi:o ce:o qui:o s':o est:v passé:v depuis:o votre:o dernière:a lettre:n ,:o Watson:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: I told him about Barrymore and the candle, and about Selden on the moor, and about Laura Lyons.
sentences.tgt: Je:o lui:o parlai:v de:o Barrymore:o et:o de:o la:o bougie:n ,:o de:o Selden:o sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o et:o de:o Laura:o Lyons:o .:o

sentences.en: "Laura Lyons wrote to Sir Charles and asked him to meet her at the gate," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Laura:o Lyons:o a:v écrit:v à:o sir:o Charles:o pour:o lui:o donner:v rendez-vous:n à:o la:o barrière:n ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "She did not go, and she will not say who helped her."
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o n':o y:o est:v pas:o allée:v ,:o et:o elle:o refuse:v de:o dire:v qui:o l':o a:v aidée:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "That is what I want to know," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Voilà:o justement:a ce:o que:o je:o veux:v savoir:v ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "Were you the man that I saw on the rock last night?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Était:v -ce:o vous:o ,:o l':o homme:n que:o j':o ai:v vu:v sur:o le:o rocher:n la:o nuit:n dernière:a ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "Yes, I saw you and Sir Henry on the moor, and I did not want you to see me," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Oui:o ,:o je:o vous:o ai:v vus:v sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o sir:o Henry:o et:o vous:o ,:o et:o je:o ne:o voulais:v pas:o que:o vous:o me:o voyiez:v ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "I saw Selden run, and I heard the cry, and I stood on the rock and watched."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v vu:v Selden:o s':o enfuir:v ,:o j':o ai:v entendu:v le:o cri:n ,:o et:o je:o suis:v resté:v sur:o le:o rocher:n à:o observer:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The man in the cab, the letter, and the boots were all the work of one man," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o L':o homme:n du:o fiacre:n ,:o la:o lettre:n et:o les:o bottines:n ,:o tout:o cela:o est:v l':o œuvre:n d':o un:o seul:a homme:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He was not Barrymore, for Barrymore was at the Hall on the day when the cab followed Sir Henry."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o n':o était:v pas:o Barrymore:o ,:o car:o Barrymore:o se:o trouvait:v au:o manoir:n le:o jour:n où:o le:o fiacre:n a:v suivi:v sir:o Henry:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He wants Sir Henry to be afraid, and he wants him to go out on the moor alone."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o veut:v que:o sir:o Henry:o ait:v peur:n ,:o et:o il:o veut:v qu':o il:o s':o aventure:v seul:a sur:o la:o lande:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Someone told Laura Lyons to write the letter, and someone wanted Sir Charles at the gate at 10," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Quelqu'un:o a:v poussé:v Laura:o Lyons:o à:o écrire:v cette:o lettre:n ,:o et:o quelqu'un:o voulait:v que:o sir:o Charles:o soit:v à:o la:o barrière:n à:o dix:o heures:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "There is a man on this moor who wants to kill a Baskerville."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o y:o a:v sur:o cette:o lande:n un:o homme:n qui:o veut:v tuer:v un:o Baskerville:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He has a hound, and he has a plan, and he is more clever than any man I have known."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o a:v un:o chien:n ,:o il:o a:v un:o plan:n ,:o et:o c':o est:v l':o homme:n le:o plus:a habile:a que:o j':o aie:v jamais:a rencontré:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Sir Charles died at the gate, and now the man wants Sir Henry to die."
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o est:v mort:v à:o la:o barrière:n ,:o et:o maintenant:a ,:o cet:o homme:n veut:v la:o mort:n de:o sir:o Henry:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Sir Henry is at Merripit House tonight, and he will walk home alone across the moor," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Henry:o est:v à:o Merripit:o House:o ce:o soir:n ,:o et:o il:o rentrera:v seul:a à:o pied:n à:o travers:n la:o lande:n ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "Alone!" Holmes said, and he got up quickly.
sentences.tgt: «:o Seul:a !:o »:o s':o écria:v Holmes:o en:o se:o levant:v d':o un:o bond:n .:o

sentences.en: "We must go now, Watson, and we must find him on the road."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o faut:v partir:v tout:a de:o suite:n ,:o Watson:o ,:o et:o le:o rejoindre:v sur:o la:o route:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: We had gone only a short way across the moor when a cry came from far away.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o avions:v à:o peine:n fait:v quelques:o pas:n sur:o la:o lande:n quand:o un:o cri:n retentit:v au:o loin:a .:o

sentences.en: It was the cry of a man in great fear.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v le:o cri:n d':o un:o homme:n fou:a de:o terreur:n .:o

sentences.en: "It is Sir Henry!" I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v sir:o Henry:o !:o »:o m':o écriai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: We ran across the moor in the light of the moon.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o courûmes:v à:o travers:n la:o lande:n ,:o au:o clair:n de:o lune:n .:o

sentences.en: The cry did not come again, and we heard only our feet on the stones.
sentences.tgt: Le:o cri:n ne:o se:o répéta:v pas:o ,:o et:o nous:o n':o entendions:v plus:o que:o nos:o pas:n sur:o les:o pierres:n .:o

sentences.en: At the foot of a high rock we found a man who lay on his face.
sentences.tgt: Au:o pied:n d':o un:o haut:a rocher:n ,:o nous:o trouvâmes:v un:o homme:n étendu:a face:n contre:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: He was dead, for his neck was broken.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v mort:a ,:o car:o il:o s':o était:v brisé:v la:o nuque:n .:o

sentences.en: He had fallen from the top of the rock, and he lay on the stones below.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v tombé:v du:o haut:n du:o rocher:n ,:o et:o il:o gisait:v sur:o les:o pierres:n en:o contrebas:a .:o

sentences.en: Holmes struck the ground with his hand and said, "I am too late, Watson."
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o frappa:v le:o sol:n de:o la:o main:n et:o dit:v ::o «:o Je:o suis:v arrivé:v trop:a tard:a ,:o Watson:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "These are the clothes of Sir Henry," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o sont:v les:o vêtements:n de:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: Holmes turned the man over, and we saw his face in the light of the moon.
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o retourna:v le:o corps:n ,:o et:o nous:o vîmes:v son:o visage:n au:o clair:n de:o lune:n .:o

sentences.en: "It is not Sir Henry," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o n':o est:v pas:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "It is Selden."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v Selden:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Barrymore gave him the old clothes of Sir Henry," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Barrymore:o lui:o avait:v donné:v les:o vieux:a vêtements:n de:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "Selden died in the clothes of Sir Henry, and I think that the hound was behind him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Selden:o est:v mort:v dans:o les:o vêtements:n de:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o et:o je:o crois:v que:o le:o chien:n était:v à:o ses:o trousses:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: A man ran toward us across the moor, and it was Stapleton.
sentences.tgt: Un:o homme:n accourait:v vers:o nous:o à:o travers:n la:o lande:n ::o c':o était:v Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: He stopped when he saw us, and his face was white.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o arrêta:v en:o nous:o voyant:v ,:o le:o visage:n blême:a .:o

sentences.en: "Doctor Watson!" Stapleton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Docteur:n Watson:o !:o »:o s':o exclama:v Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: "I heard the cry, and I was afraid that it was Sir Henry."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v entendu:v le:o cri:n ,:o et:o j':o ai:v craint:v que:o ce:o ne:o soit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "This is my friend Sherlock Holmes," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Voici:o mon:o ami:n Sherlock:o Holmes:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: Stapleton looked at Holmes, and then he looked at the dead man.
sentences.tgt: Stapleton:o regarda:v Holmes:o ,:o puis:a le:o mort:n .:o

sentences.en: "Is it Sir Henry?" he asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Est:v -ce:o sir:o Henry:o ?:o »:o demanda:v -t-il:o .:o

sentences.en: "No, it is Selden the convict," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Non:o ,:o c':o est:v Selden:o ,:o le:o forçat:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "Poor man," Stapleton said, "he ran from the hound, and he fell."
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o pauvre:a homme:n ,:o »:o dit:v Stapleton:o ,:o «:o il:o fuyait:v le:o chien:n ,:o et:o il:o est:v tombé:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I think that the hound is on the moor, and I am afraid for us all."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o crois:v que:o le:o chien:n rôde:v sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o et:o je:o crains:v pour:o nous:o tous:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Holmes did not say a word, but he looked at Stapleton for a long time.
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o ne:o dit:v pas:o un:o mot:n ,:o mais:o il:o observa:v longuement:a Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: "Sir Henry left my house at 9, and I think that he is at the Hall now," Stapleton said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Henry:o est:v parti:v de:o chez:o moi:o à:o neuf:o heures:n ,:o et:o je:o pense:v qu':o il:o est:v rentré:v au:o manoir:n à:o présent:n ,:o »:o dit:v Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: Stapleton went away across the moor, and Holmes and I stood with the dead man.
sentences.tgt: Stapleton:o s':o éloigna:v à:o travers:n la:o lande:n ,:o et:o Holmes:o et:o moi:o restâmes:v auprès:o du:o mort:n .:o

sentences.en: "Watson, the man who wanted Sir Henry dead is not far from us," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Watson:o ,:o l':o homme:n qui:o voulait:v la:o mort:n de:o sir:o Henry:o n':o est:v pas:o loin:a ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He wanted him to die in these clothes, on this moor, tonight."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o voulait:v qu':o il:o meure:v dans:o ces:o vêtements:n ,:o sur:o cette:o lande:n ,:o cette:o nuit:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But the hound killed Selden, and the man did not get what he wanted."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o le:o chien:n a:v tué:v Selden:o ,:o et:o l':o homme:n n':o a:v pas:o obtenu:v ce:o qu':o il:o voulait:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I know who the man is, and I will tell you all in the morning."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o sais:v qui:o est:v cet:o homme:n ,:o et:o je:o vous:o dirai:v tout:o demain:a matin:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: In the morning Holmes and I went to the Hall, and Sir Henry met us at the door.
sentences.tgt: Le:o matin:n ,:o Holmes:o et:o moi:o nous:o rendîmes:v au:o manoir:n ,:o où:o sir:o Henry:o nous:o accueillit:v sur:o le:o seuil:n .:o

sentences.en: "Holmes, I thought that you were in London," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Holmes:o ,:o je:o vous:o croyais:v à:o Londres:o ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "I have been on the moor, Sir Henry, and I have watched you," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o étais:v sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o et:o je:o veillais:v sur:o vous:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: Barrymore told us that Selden was dead, and Sir Henry said that he was sorry for the wife of Barrymore.
sentences.tgt: Barrymore:o nous:o apprit:v que:o Selden:o était:v mort:a ,:o et:o sir:o Henry:o dit:v qu':o il:o était:v navré:a pour:o la:o femme:n de:o Barrymore:o .:o

sentences.en: Holmes went into the great room and looked at the pictures on the wall.
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o entra:v dans:o la:o grande:a salle:n et:o examina:v les:o portraits:n accrochés:a au:o mur:n .:o

sentences.en: He stopped at a picture of a man with long hair and a big hat.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o arrêta:v devant:o le:o portrait:n d':o un:o homme:n aux:o cheveux:n longs:a ,:o coiffé:a d':o un:o grand:a chapeau:n .:o

sentences.en: "Who is he?" Holmes asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qui:o est:v -ce:o ?:o »:o demanda:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He is Hugo Baskerville," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v Hugo:o Baskerville:o ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "Watson, put your hand over his hat and his long hair, and look at his face," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Watson:o ,:o cachez:v de:o la:o main:n son:o chapeau:n et:o ses:o longs:a cheveux:n ,:o et:o regardez:v son:o visage:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: I put my hand over the hat and the hair, and I saw the face of Stapleton.
sentences.tgt: Je:o cachai:v de:o la:o main:n le:o chapeau:n et:o les:o cheveux:n ,:o et:o je:o vis:v apparaître:v le:o visage:n de:o Stapleton:o .:o

sentences.en: "Stapleton is a Baskerville," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Stapleton:o est:v un:o Baskerville:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He wants the Hall, and he wants Sir Henry dead."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o convoite:v le:o manoir:n ,:o et:o il:o veut:v la:o mort:n de:o sir:o Henry:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But how can he be a Baskerville?" Sir Henry asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o comment:a peut:v -il:o être:v un:o Baskerville:o ?:o »:o demanda:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "He has taken another name," Holmes said, "and I think that his father was a Baskerville who went to South America."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o a:v pris:v un:o autre:a nom:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o ,:o «:o et:o je:o crois:v que:o son:o père:n était:v un:o Baskerville:o parti:v pour:o l':o Amérique:o du:o Sud:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Sir Charles had no son, and if you die, the Hall will be his."
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o n':o avait:v pas:o de:o fils:n ,:o et:o si:o vous:o mourez:v ,:o le:o manoir:n lui:o reviendra:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The hound is his hound," Sir Henry said, and his face was white.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o chien:n ,:o c':o est:v le:o sien:o ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o ,:o le:o visage:n blême:a .:o

sentences.en: "You must not tell Stapleton that we know," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ne:o dites:v surtout:a pas:o à:o Stapleton:o que:o nous:o savons:v ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He asked me to dine again tomorrow, and I said that I would go," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o m':o a:v de:o nouveau:a invité:v à:o dîner:v demain:a ,:o et:o j':o ai:v accepté:v ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "You will go, and you will walk home alone across the moor," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o irez:v ,:o et:o vous:o rentrerez:v seul:a à:o pied:n à:o travers:n la:o lande:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will tell Stapleton that I am called back to London, and he will think that we are far away."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ferai:v savoir:v à:o Stapleton:o que:o je:o suis:v rappelé:v à:o Londres:o ,:o et:o il:o nous:o croira:v loin:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I will do it," Sir Henry said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o le:o ferai:v ,:o »:o dit:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "You will not be alone, for Watson and I will be near you," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o ne:o serez:v pas:o seul:a ,:o car:o Watson:o et:o moi:o serons:v près:o de:o vous:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will send a telegram to London for a friend, and he will help us."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v envoyer:v un:o télégramme:n à:o Londres:o pour:o faire:v venir:v un:o ami:n ,:o qui:o nous:o prêtera:v main-forte:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: That afternoon Holmes and I went to Coombe Tracey to see Laura Lyons.
sentences.tgt: Cet:o après-midi:n -là:o ,:o Holmes:o et:o moi:o allâmes:v à:o Coombe:o Tracey:o voir:v Laura:o Lyons:o .:o

sentences.en: "I am Sherlock Holmes, and I have come to ask about Sir Charles Baskerville," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o suis:v Sherlock:o Holmes:o ,:o et:o je:o viens:v vous:o interroger:v au:o sujet:n de:o sir:o Charles:o Baskerville:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "Doctor Watson has asked me already, and I told him all that I know," she said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o docteur:n Watson:o m':o a:v déjà:a interrogée:v ,:o et:o je:o lui:o ai:v dit:v tout:o ce:o que:o je:o sais:v ,:o »:o dit:v -elle:o .:o

sentences.en: "You told him that someone helped you, but you did not tell him who," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o lui:o avez:v dit:v que:o quelqu'un:o vous:o avait:v aidée:v ,:o mais:o vous:o ne:o lui:o avez:v pas:o dit:v qui:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He is the man who told you to write the letter."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v l':o homme:n qui:o vous:o a:v dit:v d':o écrire:v cette:o lettre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I cannot tell you," Laura said, and her face was white.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o peux:v pas:o vous:o le:o dire:v ,:o »:o dit:v Laura:o ,:o le:o visage:n blême:a .:o

sentences.en: "I will tell you," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v vous:o le:o dire:v ,:o moi:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He is Stapleton."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v Stapleton:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Laura did not speak, and she looked at the floor.
sentences.tgt: Laura:o ne:o répondit:v pas:o ,:o et:o elle:o baissa:v les:o yeux:n .:o

sentences.en: "He told you that he would marry you when you were free of your husband," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o vous:o a:v promis:v de:o vous:o épouser:v une:o fois:n que:o vous:o seriez:v libérée:a de:o votre:o mari:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He told you to write to Sir Charles, and he told you not to go to the gate."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o vous:o a:v dit:v d':o écrire:v à:o sir:o Charles:o ,:o puis:a il:o vous:o a:v dit:v de:o ne:o pas:o aller:v à:o la:o barrière:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Yes, it is true," Laura said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Oui:o ,:o c':o est:v vrai:a ,:o »:o dit:v Laura:o .:o

sentences.en: "How did you know?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Comment:a le:o saviez:v -vous:o ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "He has a wife, and she lives at Merripit House," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o est:v marié:a ,:o et:o sa:o femme:n vit:v à:o Merripit:o House:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "The woman that you call his sister is his wife."
sentences.tgt: «:o Celle:o que:o vous:o prenez:v pour:o sa:o sœur:n est:v sa:o femme:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He is a liar!" Laura cried, and she got up from her chair.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v un:o menteur:n !:o »:o s':o écria:v Laura:o en:o se:o levant:v de:o sa:o chaise:n .:o

sentences.en: "He said that he loved me, and he said that he would marry me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o m':o a:v dit:v qu':o il:o m':o aimait:v ,:o et:o qu':o il:o m':o épouserait:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Sir Charles died at the gate, and he died because of your letter," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o est:v mort:v à:o la:o barrière:n ,:o et:o il:o est:v mort:v à:o cause:n de:o votre:o lettre:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "I did not know that he would die," Laura said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o savais:v pas:o qu':o il:o allait:v mourir:v ,:o »:o dit:v Laura:o .:o

sentences.en: "I did not want him to die."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o voulais:v pas:o sa:o mort:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Stapleton said that he would give me money for my case, and he said that I must not go to the gate."
sentences.tgt: «:o Stapleton:o m':o avait:v promis:v de:o l':o argent:n pour:o mon:o divorce:n ,:o et:o il:o m':o avait:v dit:v de:o ne:o pas:o aller:v à:o la:o barrière:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I thought that he loved me, and I did what he said."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o croyais:v qu':o il:o m':o aimait:v ,:o et:o j':o ai:v fait:v ce:o qu':o il:o me:o disait:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I will tell you all that I know, for I do not want to help that man."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v vous:o dire:v tout:o ce:o que:o je:o sais:v ,:o car:o je:o ne:o veux:v plus:o aider:v cet:o homme:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Tell me all that you know," Holmes said, "and I will not say that you helped him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Dites:v -moi:o tout:o ce:o que:o vous:o savez:v ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o ,:o «:o et:o je:o ne:o dirai:v pas:o que:o vous:o l':o avez:v aidé:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "You must tell no one, and you must stay in your house until we come again."
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o ne:o devez:v en:o parler:v à:o personne:o ,:o et:o vous:o resterez:v chez:o vous:o jusqu':o à:o notre:o retour:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I will do it," Laura said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o le:o ferai:v ,:o »:o dit:v Laura:o .:o

sentences.en: The next morning Holmes told Sir Henry what to do.
sentences.tgt: Le:o lendemain:n matin:n ,:o Holmes:o expliqua:v à:o sir:o Henry:o ce:o qu':o il:o devait:v faire:v .:o

sentences.en: "Send a note to Stapleton, and say that Watson and I have gone back to London," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Envoyez:v un:o mot:n à:o Stapleton:o pour:o lui:o dire:v que:o Watson:o et:o moi:o sommes:v rentrés:v à:o Londres:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He will think that you are alone tonight, and he will let his hound out."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o vous:o croira:v seul:a ce:o soir:n ,:o et:o il:o lâchera:v son:o chien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry wrote the note and sent it to Merripit House.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o écrivit:v le:o mot:n et:o le:o fit:v porter:v à:o Merripit:o House:o .:o

sentences.en: In the afternoon Holmes and I went to the small station on the road.
sentences.tgt: L':o après-midi:n ,:o Holmes:o et:o moi:o nous:o rendîmes:v à:o la:o petite:a gare:n ,:o au:o bord:n de:o la:o route:n .:o

sentences.en: A train came in, and a short man with a hard face got out.
sentences.tgt: Un:o train:n entra:v en:o gare:n ,:o et:o un:o petit:a homme:n au:o visage:n dur:a en:o descendit:v .:o

sentences.en: He was Lestrade, a man of the police in London, and Holmes had sent for him.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v Lestrade:o ,:o de:o la:o police:n de:o Londres:o ,:o que:o Holmes:o avait:v fait:v venir:v .:o

sentences.en: "I am glad that you have come," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o suis:v heureux:a que:o vous:o soyez:v venu:v ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "What is the case, Holmes?" Lestrade asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o De:o quelle:o affaire:n s':o agit:v -il:o ,:o Holmes:o ?:o »:o demanda:v Lestrade:o .:o

sentences.en: "A man on this moor killed Sir Charles Baskerville, and tonight he will try to kill Sir Henry," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o homme:n ,:o sur:o cette:o lande:n ,:o a:v tué:v sir:o Charles:o Baskerville:o ,:o et:o ce:o soir:n ,:o il:o va:v tenter:v de:o tuer:v sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He keeps a hound, and the hound is not a story."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o a:v un:o chien:n ,:o et:o ce:o chien:n n':o a:v rien:o d':o une:o légende:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "What is the man's name?" Lestrade asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Comment:a s':o appelle:v cet:o homme:n ?:o »:o demanda:v Lestrade:o .:o

sentences.en: "His name is Stapleton, and he lives at Merripit House," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o s':o appelle:v Stapleton:o ,:o et:o il:o habite:v Merripit:o House:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "We will catch him tonight, and we will catch him with the hound."
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o allons:v le:o prendre:v ce:o soir:n ,:o et:o nous:o le:o prendrons:v avec:o son:o chien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Where will he do it?" Lestrade asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:o va:v -t-il:o frapper:v ?:o »:o demanda:v Lestrade:o .:o

sentences.en: "Sir Henry will walk home alone across the moor, and the hound will go after him," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Henry:o rentrera:v seul:a à:o pied:n à:o travers:n la:o lande:n ,:o et:o le:o chien:n se:o lancera:v à:o sa:o poursuite:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "We will be near, and we will shoot the hound before it reaches him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o serons:v tout:a près:a ,:o et:o nous:o abattrons:v le:o chien:n avant:o qu':o il:o ne:o l':o atteigne:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I do not like it," Lestrade said, "for the hound may kill Sir Henry."
sentences.tgt: «:o Cela:o ne:o me:o plaît:v pas:o ,:o »:o dit:v Lestrade:o ,:o «:o car:o le:o chien:n risque:v de:o tuer:v sir:o Henry:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "It will not," Holmes said, "for we will be near."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o ne:o le:o tuera:v pas:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o ,:o «:o car:o nous:o serons:v tout:a près:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: The three of us went out onto the moor as the sun went down.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o partîmes:v tous:o les:o trois:o sur:o la:o lande:n au:o coucher:n du:o soleil:n .:o

sentences.en: We stopped at a hill near Merripit House, and we sat down behind some rocks.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o fîmes:v halte:n sur:o une:o colline:n près:o de:o Merripit:o House:o ,:o et:o nous:o nous:o assîmes:v derrière:o des:o rochers:n .:o

sentences.en: From the hill we could see the house and the path that Sir Henry would walk.
sentences.tgt: De:o la:o colline:n ,:o nous:o apercevions:v la:o maison:n et:o le:o sentier:n que:o prendrait:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "We will wait here for Sir Henry," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o attendrons:v sir:o Henry:o ici:a ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: The night was cold, and I saw a white fog on the mire.
sentences.tgt: La:o nuit:n était:v froide:a ,:o et:o je:o vis:v un:o brouillard:n blanc:a se:o former:v sur:o la:o fondrière:n .:o

sentences.en: We waited behind the rocks for a long time, and the night grew colder.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o attendîmes:v longtemps:a derrière:o les:o rochers:n ,:o et:o la:o nuit:n se:o fit:v plus:a froide:a .:o

sentences.en: Below us the fog lay on the mire, and slowly it came up toward the path.
sentences.tgt: En:o contrebas:a ,:o le:o brouillard:n recouvrait:v la:o fondrière:n ,:o et:o il:o montait:v lentement:a vers:o le:o sentier:n .:o

sentences.en: "If the fog comes up to the path, we will not see Sir Henry," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Si:o le:o brouillard:n atteint:v le:o sentier:n ,:o nous:o ne:o verrons:v plus:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "We will hear the hound before we see it," Holmes said, and he did not speak again.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o entendrons:v le:o chien:n avant:o de:o le:o voir:v ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o ,:o et:o il:o ne:o prononça:v plus:o un:o mot:n .:o

sentences.en: Lestrade held his gun in both hands and looked at the door of Merripit House.
sentences.tgt: Lestrade:o tenait:v son:o arme:n à:o deux:o mains:n et:o fixait:v la:o porte:n de:o Merripit:o House:o .:o

sentences.en: At 10 o'clock the door of the house opened, and Sir Henry came out.
sentences.tgt: À:o dix:o heures:n ,:o la:o porte:n de:o la:o maison:n s':o ouvrit:v ,:o et:o sir:o Henry:o sortit:v .:o

sentences.en: He walked along the path toward us, and he did not know that we were watching him.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o avança:v sur:o le:o sentier:n dans:o notre:o direction:n ,:o sans:o savoir:v que:o nous:o l':o observions:v .:o

sentences.en: The fog was thick now, and I could see only the lights of the house behind him.
sentences.tgt: Le:o brouillard:n était:v épais:a à:o présent:n ,:o et:o je:o ne:o distinguais:v plus:o que:o les:o lumières:n de:o la:o maison:n derrière:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: Lestrade put his hand on my arm and whispered, "Do you hear that?"
sentences.tgt: Lestrade:o posa:v la:o main:n sur:o mon:o bras:n et:o chuchota:v ::o «:o Vous:o entendez:v ?:o »:o

sentences.en: I heard the feet of a big animal running fast on the stones, and the sound came from behind Sir Henry.
sentences.tgt: J':o entendis:v les:o pattes:n d':o une:o grosse:a bête:n qui:o courait:v à:o toute:o allure:n sur:o les:o pierres:n ,:o et:o le:o bruit:n venait:v de:o derrière:o sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: A great black hound came out of the fog.
sentences.tgt: Un:o énorme:a chien:n noir:a surgit:v du:o brouillard:n .:o

sentences.en: Fire shone on its open mouth and on its eyes, and a line of fire ran along its neck.
sentences.tgt: Un:o feu:n luisait:v sur:o sa:o gueule:n ouverte:a et:o dans:o ses:o yeux:n ,:o et:o une:o traînée:n de:o feu:n courait:v sur:o son:o cou:n .:o

sentences.en: It was larger than any hound that I had ever seen, and it ran without a sound.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v plus:a grand:a que:o tous:o les:o chiens:n que:o j':o avais:v jamais:a vus:v ,:o et:o il:o courait:v sans:o un:o bruit:n .:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry looked back and cried out, and then he ran along the path.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o se:o retourna:v et:o poussa:v un:o cri:n ,:o puis:a il:o s':o enfuit:v en:o courant:v sur:o le:o sentier:n .:o

sentences.en: The hound ran after him, and it was faster than he was.
sentences.tgt: Le:o chien:n se:o lança:v à:o sa:o poursuite:n ,:o et:o il:o courait:v plus:a vite:a que:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: "Now!" Holmes said, and he stood up and shot at the hound.
sentences.tgt: «:o Maintenant:a !:o »:o cria:v Holmes:o ,:o et:o il:o se:o leva:v pour:o tirer:v sur:o le:o chien:n .:o

sentences.en: Lestrade shot at it too, and I shot at it also, but it did not stop.
sentences.tgt: Lestrade:o tira:v à:o son:o tour:n ,:o et:o moi:o aussi:a ,:o mais:o la:o bête:n ne:o s':o arrêta:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: The hound ran on until it was close behind Sir Henry, and Holmes ran onto the path and shot again.
sentences.tgt: Le:o chien:n continua:v sa:o course:n jusqu':o à:o se:o trouver:v juste:a derrière:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o et:o Holmes:o s':o élança:v sur:o le:o sentier:n et:o tira:v de:o nouveau:a .:o

sentences.en: It cried out and fell on its side, and Holmes shot it again in the head.
sentences.tgt: La:o bête:n hurla:v et:o s':o effondra:v sur:o le:o flanc:n ,:o et:o Holmes:o lui:o tira:v une:o nouvelle:a balle:n dans:o la:o tête:n .:o

sentences.en: For a moment no one spoke, and we heard only the fog and our own breath.
sentences.tgt: Pendant:o un:o moment:n ,:o personne:o ne:o parla:v ,:o et:o nous:o n':o entendions:v plus:o que:o le:o silence:n du:o brouillard:n et:o notre:o propre:a souffle:n .:o

sentences.en: "It is dead," Holmes said, and he bent over the hound.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o est:v mort:a ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o en:o se:o penchant:v sur:o le:o chien:n .:o

sentences.en: "Look at the fire on its mouth, Watson, for it is not a fire."
sentences.tgt: «:o Regardez:v ce:o feu:n sur:o sa:o gueule:n ,:o Watson:o ,:o car:o ce:o n':o est:v pas:o du:o feu:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "It is a paint that shines in the dark."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v une:o peinture:n qui:o luit:v dans:o l':o obscurité:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The man put it on the hound so that it would look like the hound of the story."
sentences.tgt: «:o L':o homme:n en:o a:v enduit:v le:o chien:n pour:o qu':o il:o ressemble:v au:o chien:n de:o la:o légende:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry lay on the ground, and I ran to him.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o gisait:v à:o terre:n ,:o et:o je:o courus:v vers:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: He was alive, but he could not speak, and his face was white.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v vivant:a ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o parler:v ,:o et:o son:o visage:n était:v blême:a .:o

sentences.en: "He is safe, and the hound will not hurt him now," Lestrade said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o est:v sain:a et:o sauf:a ,:o et:o le:o chien:n ne:o lui:o fera:v plus:o de:o mal:n ,:o »:o dit:v Lestrade:o .:o

sentences.en: Holmes looked at the dead hound, and then he looked at Merripit House.
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o regarda:v le:o chien:n mort:a ,:o puis:a il:o tourna:v les:o yeux:n vers:o Merripit:o House:o .:o

sentences.en: "We have the hound," he said, "but where is the man?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o tenons:v le:o chien:n ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o ,:o «:o mais:o où:o est:v l':o homme:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry sat up slowly, and Lestrade gave him something to drink.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o se:o redressa:v lentement:a ,:o et:o Lestrade:o lui:o donna:v quelque:o chose:n à:o boire:v .:o

sentences.en: "Where is the hound?" Sir Henry asked in a weak voice.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:o est:v le:o chien:n ?:o »:o demanda:v sir:o Henry:o d':o une:o voix:n faible:a .:o

sentences.en: "It is dead, Sir Henry, and it will not hurt you," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o est:v mort:a ,:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o et:o il:o ne:o vous:o fera:v plus:o de:o mal:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "Stay here with Lestrade, for Watson and I must go to Merripit House."
sentences.tgt: «:o Restez:v ici:a avec:o Lestrade:o ,:o car:o Watson:o et:o moi:o devons:v aller:v à:o Merripit:o House:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Holmes and I ran along the path to the house, and we found the door open.
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o et:o moi:o courûmes:v jusqu':o à:o la:o maison:n par:o le:o sentier:n ,:o et:o nous:o trouvâmes:v la:o porte:n ouverte:a .:o

sentences.en: We looked in every room, but there was no light in any of them, and Stapleton was not there.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o fouillâmes:v toutes:o les:o pièces:n ,:o mais:o aucune:o n':o était:v éclairée:a ,:o et:o Stapleton:o n':o était:v pas:o là:a .:o

sentences.en: At the top of the house there was a door that was shut, and we heard a sound behind it.
sentences.tgt: Tout:a en:o haut:n de:o la:o maison:n ,:o il:o y:o avait:v une:o porte:n fermée:a ,:o et:o nous:o entendîmes:v un:o bruit:n derrière:o .:o

sentences.en: Holmes broke the door, and we found Beryl in the room.
sentences.tgt: Holmes:o enfonça:v la:o porte:n ,:o et:o nous:o trouvâmes:v Beryl:o dans:o la:o pièce:n .:o

sentences.en: She was tied with cloth, and there was a mark on her face.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o était:v ligotée:a avec:o des:o bandes:n de:o tissu:n ,:o et:o elle:o portait:v une:o marque:n au:o visage:n .:o

sentences.en: "Where is he?" Holmes asked, as I took the cloth from her hands.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:o est:v -il:o ?:o »:o demanda:v Holmes:o ,:o tandis:o que:o je:o lui:o déliais:v les:o mains:n .:o

sentences.en: "He has gone to the mire," Beryl said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o est:v parti:v vers:o la:o fondrière:n ,:o »:o dit:v Beryl:o .:o

sentences.en: "He is my husband, and he is not my brother."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v mon:o mari:n ,:o ce:o n':o est:v pas:o mon:o frère:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He hit me, for I would not help him, and he tied me here."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o m':o a:v frappée:v parce:o que:o je:o refusais:v de:o l':o aider:v ,:o et:o il:o m':o a:v attachée:v ici:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He told me to say that I was his sister, and I did as he said."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o m':o avait:v ordonné:v de:o me:o faire:v passer:v pour:o sa:o sœur:n ,:o et:o j':o ai:v obéi:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But I did not want Sir Henry to die," she said to me.
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o je:o ne:o voulais:v pas:o la:o mort:n de:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o »:o me:o dit:v -elle:o .:o

sentences.en: "I wrote to him in London, and I told you to go back."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o lui:o ai:v écrit:v à:o Londres:o ,:o et:o je:o vous:o ai:v dit:v de:o repartir:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He kept the hound in a hole in the mire, and there is a path that only he knows."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o gardait:v le:o chien:n dans:o un:o trou:n au:o milieu:n de:o la:o fondrière:n ,:o où:o mène:v un:o sentier:n que:o lui:o seul:a connaît:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "We cannot follow him in the fog," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o ne:o pouvons:v pas:o le:o suivre:v dans:o ce:o brouillard:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He knows the path, and we do not, and the mire is a bad place in the night."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o connaît:v le:o sentier:n ,:o nous:o non:o ,:o et:o la:o fondrière:n est:v dangereuse:a la:o nuit:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Will he come back?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Reviendra:v -t-il:o ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "I do not think so, Watson, for he knows that we have killed his hound," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o crois:v pas:o ,:o Watson:o ,:o car:o il:o sait:v que:o nous:o avons:v tué:v son:o chien:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: We took Beryl down to Sir Henry, and we waited there until the fog began to go.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o conduisîmes:v Beryl:o auprès:o de:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o et:o nous:o attendîmes:v là:a que:o le:o brouillard:n commence:v à:o se:o dissiper:v .:o

sentences.en: In the morning we went to the mire with Beryl, and the sun was bright on the moor.
sentences.tgt: Au:o matin:n ,:o nous:o allâmes:v à:o la:o fondrière:n avec:o Beryl:o ,:o et:o le:o soleil:n brillait:v sur:o la:o lande:n .:o

sentences.en: She showed us the path, and there were small white sticks in the mire.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o nous:o montra:v le:o sentier:n ,:o balisé:a de:o petits:a bâtons:n blancs:a plantés:a dans:o la:o fondrière:n .:o

sentences.en: We found a boot on the path, and it was the old black boot of Sir Henry.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o trouvâmes:v une:o bottine:n sur:o le:o sentier:n ::o c':o était:v la:o vieille:a bottine:n noire:a de:o sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: We looked for Stapleton for a long time, but we did not find him.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o cherchâmes:v longtemps:a Stapleton:o ,:o mais:o nous:o ne:o le:o trouvâmes:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: I think that he fell into the mire in the night, and that he died there.
sentences.tgt: Je:o crois:v qu':o il:o est:v tombé:v dans:o la:o fondrière:n pendant:o la:o nuit:n ,:o et:o qu':o il:o y:o a:v trouvé:v la:o mort:n .:o

sentences.en: Two days later Holmes told Sir Henry and me all that he knew.
sentences.tgt: Deux:o jours:n plus:a tard:a ,:o Holmes:o nous:o raconta:v ,:o à:o sir:o Henry:o et:o à:o moi:o ,:o tout:o ce:o qu':o il:o savait:v .:o

sentences.en: "Stapleton was the son of Rodger Baskerville, the brother of Sir Charles," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Stapleton:o était:v le:o fils:n de:o Rodger:o Baskerville:o ,:o le:o frère:n de:o sir:o Charles:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "Rodger went to South America and died there, and his son came back to England with a wife and a new name."
sentences.tgt: «:o Rodger:o est:v parti:v pour:o l':o Amérique:o du:o Sud:o ,:o où:o il:o est:v mort:v ,:o et:o son:o fils:n est:v revenu:v en:o Angleterre:o avec:o une:o épouse:n et:o un:o nouveau:a nom:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He wanted the Hall, and two men stood between him and the Hall."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o convoitait:v le:o manoir:n ,:o et:o deux:o hommes:n se:o dressaient:v entre:o lui:o et:o l':o héritage:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "They were Sir Charles and Sir Henry."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o étaient:v sir:o Charles:o et:o sir:o Henry:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "How do you know all this, Holmes?" Sir Henry asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Comment:a savez:v -vous:o tout:o cela:o ,:o Holmes:o ?:o »:o demanda:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "I learned some of it in London, and I learned the rest here on the moor," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o en:o ai:v appris:v une:o partie:n à:o Londres:o ,:o et:o le:o reste:n ici:a ,:o sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "He bought a big hound in London, and he brought it to the moor."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o a:v acheté:v un:o gros:a chien:n à:o Londres:o ,:o et:o il:o l':o a:v amené:v sur:o la:o lande:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He kept the hound in a hole in the mire, and he put paint on it so that it would shine in the dark."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o gardait:v le:o chien:n dans:o un:o trou:n au:o milieu:n de:o la:o fondrière:n ,:o et:o il:o l':o enduisait:v de:o peinture:n pour:o qu':o il:o luise:v dans:o l':o obscurité:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The cry that you heard on the moor was the cry of the hound."
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o cri:n que:o vous:o avez:v entendu:v sur:o la:o lande:n ,:o c':o était:v celui:o du:o chien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry listened and did not speak.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o écoutait:v en:o silence:n .:o

sentences.en: "The people on the moor were afraid, for they knew the story of Hugo."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o gens:n de:o la:o lande:n avaient:v peur:n ,:o car:o ils:o connaissaient:v la:o légende:n de:o Hugo:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Stapleton knew that Sir Charles had a weak heart, and he knew that Sir Charles was afraid of the story."
sentences.tgt: «:o Stapleton:o savait:v que:o sir:o Charles:o avait:v le:o cœur:n fragile:a ,:o et:o que:o la:o légende:n le:o terrifiait:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He told Laura Lyons to write to Sir Charles, and he told her not to go to the gate."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o a:v dit:v à:o Laura:o Lyons:o d':o écrire:v à:o sir:o Charles:o ,:o puis:a il:o lui:o a:v dit:v de:o ne:o pas:o aller:v à:o la:o barrière:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Sir Charles went to the gate at 10, and he waited for her."
sentences.tgt: «:o Sir:o Charles:o s':o est:v rendu:v à:o la:o barrière:n à:o dix:o heures:n ,:o et:o il:o l':o a:v attendue:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The hound came up the path, and Sir Charles saw it and ran."
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o chien:n a:v remonté:v l':o allée:n ,:o et:o sir:o Charles:o l':o a:v vu:v et:o s':o est:v enfui:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He ran down the path in great fear, and he died there."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o a:v descendu:v l':o allée:n en:o courant:v ,:o fou:a de:o terreur:n ,:o et:o il:o y:o est:v mort:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The hound did not touch him, but its feet made the marks that Doctor Mortimer saw."
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o chien:n ne:o l':o a:v pas:o touché:v ,:o mais:o ses:o pattes:n ont:v laissé:v les:o empreintes:n qu':o a:v vues:v le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Stapleton was there, and he saw Sir Charles die."
sentences.tgt: «:o Stapleton:o était:v là:a ,:o et:o il:o a:v vu:v mourir:v sir:o Charles:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He called the hound away, and it went back to the mire."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o a:v rappelé:v le:o chien:n ,:o qui:o est:v retourné:v à:o la:o fondrière:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He thought that no one would know, for men would say that the heart of Sir Charles was bad."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o pensait:v que:o personne:o ne:o saurait:v rien:o ,:o car:o on:o dirait:v que:o sir:o Charles:o avait:v le:o cœur:n malade:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "What about the letter that came to me in London, and my boots?" Sir Henry asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Et:o la:o lettre:n que:o j':o ai:v reçue:v à:o Londres:o ,:o et:o mes:o bottines:n ?:o »:o demanda:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "Stapleton followed you to London, and his wife went with him," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Stapleton:o vous:o a:v suivi:v à:o Londres:o ,:o et:o sa:o femme:n l':o accompagnait:v ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "Beryl sent you the letter, for she did not want you to die, and the scent on the paper was hers."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v Beryl:o qui:o vous:o a:v envoyé:v la:o lettre:n ,:o car:o elle:o ne:o voulait:v pas:o votre:o mort:n ,:o et:o le:o parfum:n sur:o le:o papier:n était:v le:o sien:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The words were cut from a newspaper, and she wrote the word moor herself."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o mots:n avaient:v été:v découpés:v dans:o un:o journal:n ,:o et:o elle:o avait:v écrit:v elle-même:o le:o mot:n OQ:o lande:n CQ:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Stapleton did not know about the letter, for she was afraid of him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Stapleton:o ignorait:v tout:o de:o cette:o lettre:n ,:o car:o elle:o avait:v peur:n de:o lui:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The man in the cab was Stapleton, and his beard was false."
sentences.tgt: «:o L':o homme:n du:o fiacre:n ,:o c':o était:v Stapleton:o ,:o et:o sa:o barbe:n était:v fausse:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He gave my name to the driver, for he wanted me to know that he was not afraid of me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o a:v donné:v mon:o nom:n au:o cocher:n ,:o car:o il:o voulait:v me:o faire:v savoir:v qu':o il:o ne:o me:o craignait:v pas:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "A hound must smell something that a man has worn, or it will not follow him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o chien:n doit:v flairer:v un:o objet:n qu':o un:o homme:n a:v porté:v ,:o sinon:o il:o ne:o le:o suivra:v pas:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Stapleton took your new boot first, but no man had worn it, and he sent it back."
sentences.tgt: «:o Stapleton:o a:v d':o abord:a pris:v votre:o bottine:n neuve:a ,:o mais:o personne:o ne:o l':o avait:v jamais:o portée:v ,:o alors:a il:o l':o a:v renvoyée:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "After that he took your old black boot, and he gave it to the hound to smell."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ensuite:a ,:o il:o a:v pris:v votre:o vieille:a bottine:n noire:a ,:o et:o il:o l':o a:v donnée:v à:o flairer:v au:o chien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "That is the boot that you lost at the hotel, Sir Henry."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v la:o bottine:n que:o vous:o avez:v perdue:v à:o l':o hôtel:n ,:o sir:o Henry:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Selden died because he wore your old clothes, Sir Henry."
sentences.tgt: «:o Selden:o est:v mort:v parce:o qu':o il:o portait:v vos:o vieux:a vêtements:n ,:o sir:o Henry:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Barrymore gave them to him, and the hound followed the smell of the clothes."
sentences.tgt: «:o Barrymore:o les:o lui:o avait:v donnés:v ,:o et:o le:o chien:n a:v suivi:v l':o odeur:n de:o ces:o vêtements:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Selden ran from the hound in the night and fell from the rock."
sentences.tgt: «:o Dans:o la:o nuit:n ,:o Selden:o a:v fui:v devant:o le:o chien:n et:o il:o est:v tombé:v du:o rocher:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "When I saw the clothes on him, I thought that he was you, Sir Henry, and I was afraid."
sentences.tgt: «:o Quand:o j':o ai:v vu:v ces:o vêtements:n sur:o lui:o ,:o j':o ai:v cru:v que:o c':o était:v vous:o ,:o sir:o Henry:o ,:o et:o j':o ai:v eu:v peur:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Stapleton went into the mire with the old black boot, and we found the boot on the path."
sentences.tgt: «:o Stapleton:o s':o est:v enfoncé:v dans:o la:o fondrière:n avec:o la:o vieille:a bottine:n noire:a ,:o et:o nous:o l':o avons:v retrouvée:v sur:o le:o sentier:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I do not think that he came out of the mire."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o crois:v pas:o qu':o il:o en:o soit:v ressorti:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Why did Beryl help him?" Sir Henry asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a Beryl:o l':o a:v -t-elle:o aidé:v ?:o »:o demanda:v sir:o Henry:o .:o

sentences.en: "She was his wife, and she was afraid of him," Holmes said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o était:v sa:o femme:n ,:o et:o elle:o avait:v peur:n de:o lui:o ,:o »:o dit:v Holmes:o .:o

sentences.en: "But she would not help him kill you, and so he tied her in the room."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o elle:o a:v refusé:v de:o l':o aider:v à:o vous:o tuer:v ,:o et:o c':o est:v pourquoi:a il:o l':o a:v attachée:v dans:o cette:o chambre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Beryl was safe, and she went far away from the moor.
sentences.tgt: Beryl:o était:v hors:o de:o danger:n ,:o et:o elle:o s':o en:o alla:v loin:a de:o la:o lande:n .:o

sentences.en: Sir Henry went on a long journey with Doctor Mortimer, and Holmes and I went back to London.
sentences.tgt: Sir:o Henry:o partit:v pour:o un:o long:a voyage:n avec:o le:o docteur:n Mortimer:o ,:o et:o Holmes:o et:o moi:o rentrâmes:v à:o Londres:o .:o
